en: The spirit of self-estrangement has its determinate being in the world of culture; but since this whole has itself been estranged, there stands beyond it the unreal world of pure consciousness or of thinking.
Its content is the purely thought, thinking is its absolute element.

But since thinking is at first the element of this world, consciousness has only these thoughts, but it does not yet think them, or does not know that they are thoughts; rather, they are for it in the form of representation.
For it steps out of actuality into pure consciousness, but it is itself still altogether within the sphere and determinacy of actuality.
The torn consciousness is in itself, to begin with, the self-sameness of pure consciousness for us, not for itself.

It is therefore only the immediate elevation, not yet completed within itself, and it still has within itself its opposed principle, by which it is conditioned, without having become master over it through the mediated movement.

Hence the essence of its thought counts for it not as essence merely in the form of the abstract in-itself, but in the form of a common actuality, an actuality that has only been elevated into another element, without having lost in this element the determinacy of an unthought actuality.

- It is essentially to be distinguished from the in-itself that is the essence of stoical consciousness; for the latter, only the form of thought as such counted, while it has thereby any content foreign to it, taken from actuality; for that consciousness, however, it is not the form of thought that is what counts; - likewise [it is essentially to be distinguished] from the in-itself of virtuous consciousness, for which the essence indeed stands in relation to actuality, for which it is the essence of actuality itself, but is only as yet unreal essence; - for that consciousness it counts as being, though beyond actuality, yet actual essence.
Likewise, the right and good that are in themselves of law-giving reason, and the universal of law-testing consciousness, do not have the determination of actuality.

- If therefore, within the world of culture itself, pure thinking fell as one side of estrangement, namely as the standard of the abstract good and evil in judging, then it has, having passed through the movement of the whole, been enriched by the moment of actuality and thereby of content.

But this actuality of the essence is at the same time only an actuality of pure, not of actual consciousness; though elevated into the element of thinking, it still does not count for this consciousness as a thought, but rather it is for it beyond its own actuality; for the former is the flight from the latter.
zh: 自身异化了的精神在教养的世界里有它的定在；但这个整体既然自己异化了，在它之外就站着纯粹意识或思维的、不现实的世界。
它的内容是纯粹被思维的东西，思维是它的绝对要素。
但思维最初只是这个世界的要素，所以意识只有这些思想，却还没有思维它们，或者不知道它们是思想；不如说，它们对它是以表象的形式出现的。
因为它从现实性走入纯粹意识，但它自己却还完全处在现实性的领域和规定性之中。
撕裂了的意识自在地首先只是纯粹意识的自身等同，这是对我们而言，不是对它自己而言。
所以它只是直接的、还没有在自身内完成的提升，并且还在自身内带有它那个对立的原则，它受这个原则制约，却没有通过中介的运动而成为这个原则的主人。
因此，它思维的本质对它来说并不是仅仅以抽象自在的形式出现的本质，而是以一个共同现实的、一种现实性的形式出现的，这种现实性只是被提升到了另一个要素里，却没有在这个要素里失掉一种未被思维的现实性的规定性。
——它本质上要与斯多葛主义意识的自在区别开来；对后者来说，只有思想本身的形式才算数，而它在这里带有某种对它陌生的、从现实性中取来的内容；对那种意识来说，却不是思想的形式在起作用；——同样［它本质上要与］德行意识的自在区别开来，对后者来说，本质虽然处在与现实性的关系里，对它来说是现实性本身的本质，但只是尚未现实的本质；——对那种意识来说，它虽然在实际性之外，却算作现实的本质。
同样，立法的理性那些自在的法权和善，以及审查法则的意识的普遍者，也没有现实性的规定。
——所以，如果在教养的世界内部，纯粹思维本身就是作为异化的一个方面出现的，也就是作为在判断中抽象善与恶的尺度，那么它既然通过了整体的运动，就被现实性这一环节、从而也被内容充实了。
但本质的这种现实性同时只是一种纯粹意识的现实性，而不是现实意识的现实性；它虽然被提升到了思维的要素里，对纯粹意识来说却还不算作一种思想，不如说，它对纯粹意识来说是在它自己的现实性之外的；因为前一种现实性是逃避后一种现实性。

en: As religion here - for it is clear that religion is what is being spoken of - comes on the scene as the faith of the world of culture, it does not yet come on the scene as it is in and for itself.
- It has already appeared to us in other determinacies, namely as unhappy consciousness, as the shape of the substanceless movement of consciousness itself.

- On ethical substance too it appeared as faith in the underworld; but the consciousness of the departed spirit is properly not faith, not the essence posited in the element of pure consciousness beyond the actual, but it has itself immediate presence; its element is the family.
Here, however, religion has partly emerged from substance and is the pure consciousness of it; partly this pure consciousness is estranged from its actual, the essence from its determinate being.

Thus it is indeed no longer the substanceless movement of consciousness, but it still has the determinacy of the opposition to actuality as this actuality in general and to that of self-consciousness in particular; it is therefore essentially only a faith.
zh: 宗教在这里——因为很明显，说的正是宗教——作为教养世界的信仰出现时，它还没有以它自在自为的样子出现。
——它已经在其他规定性中向我们显现过，也就是作为苦恼意识，作为意识自身那种无实体运动的形态。
——在伦理实体上它也显现为对冥府的信仰；但已分离的精神的意识其实并不是信仰，不是把本质设定在现实之外的纯粹意识要素里，而是它自己就有直接的当下存在；它的要素是家庭。
但在这里，宗教一方面是从实体中产生出来的，是实体的纯粹意识；另一方面，这种纯粹意识与它的现实的东西、本质与它的定在是异化了的。
所以它虽然不再是意识的无实体运动，却还带有与现实性相对立的规定性，既与一般现实性相对立，也与自我意识的现实性相对立；因此它本质上只是一种信仰。

en: This pure consciousness of the absolute essence is an estranged one.
It is to be seen more closely how that of which it is the other determines itself, and it is only to be considered in connection with this other.

At first, namely, this pure consciousness seems to have only the world of actuality over against it; but since it is the flight from this world and thereby the determinacy of opposition, it has this world on itself; pure consciousness is therefore essentially estranged from itself, and faith makes up only one side of it.
The other side has at the same time already arisen for us.

For pure consciousness is the reflection out of the world of culture in such a way that the substance of this world, as well as the masses into which it articulates itself, showed themselves as what they are in themselves, as spiritual essences, as absolutely restless movements or determinacies that immediately sublate themselves in their opposite.
Their essence, simple consciousness, is therefore the simplicity of the absolute difference, which immediately is no difference.

It is thereby pure being-for-itself, not as that of this single individual, but the self that is universal within itself, as restless movement that attacks and penetrates the calm essence of the matter.

In it, therefore, the certainty that knows itself immediately as truth, pure thinking as the absolute concept, is present in the power of its negativity, which annihilates everything objective, every essence that is supposed to be over against consciousness, and makes it into a being of consciousness.
- This pure consciousness is at the same time just as much simple, because precisely its difference is no difference.

But as this form of simple reflection-into-itself, it is the element of faith, in which the spirit has the determinacy of positive universality, of being-in-itself, as against that being-for-itself of self-consciousness.

- Driven back into itself out of the essenceless world that only dissolves itself, the spirit is, according to the truth, in undivided unity both the absolute movement and negativity of its appearing and its essence satisfied within itself and its positive rest.
But lying altogether under the determinacy of estrangement, these two moments fall apart as a doubled consciousness.

The former is pure insight, as the spiritual process that gathers itself in self-consciousness, which has over against it the consciousness of the positive, the form of objectivity or of representing, and directs itself against it; but its own object is only the pure I.
- The simple consciousness of the positive, or of calm self-sameness, by contrast, has inner essence as essence for its object.
Pure insight therefore at first has no content in itself, because it is negative being-for-itself; faith, by contrast, has the content, without insight.

If the former does not step out of self-consciousness, the latter likewise has its content in the element of pure self-consciousness, but in thinking, not in concepts, in pure consciousness, not in pure self-consciousness.
It is thereby indeed pure consciousness of the essence, that is, of the simple inner, and is therefore thinking - the principal moment in the nature of faith, which is ordinarily overlooked.
The immediacy with which the essence is in it lies in this, that its object is essence, that is, pure thought.

But this immediacy, insofar as thinking enters consciousness, or pure consciousness enters self-consciousness, receives the meaning of an objective being that lies beyond the consciousness of the self.

Through this meaning that the immediacy and simplicity of pure thinking receives in consciousness, it is that the essence of faith falls out of thinking into representation and becomes a supersensuous world, which is essentially an other of self-consciousness.

- In pure insight, by contrast, the transition of pure thinking into consciousness has the opposite determinacy; objectivity has the meaning of a merely negative content that sublates itself and returns into the self, that is, only the self is properly the object for itself, or the object has truth only insofar as it has the form of the self.
zh: 绝对本质的这种纯粹意识是一种异化了的意识。
还要更切近地看一看，它是其另一方的那个东西如何规定自己，并且它只有和这另一方联系起来才能考察。
起初，这种纯粹意识似乎只是把现实性的世界作为对立面；但既然它是从这个世界逃开，从而就是对立的规定性，它就自身带有这个世界；所以纯粹意识本质上是在自身那里就异化了的，而信仰只构成它的一个方面。
另一方面对我们来说同时已经产生出来了。
因为纯粹意识是从教养的世界中反思出来的，以至于这个世界的实体以及它分成的一些群体都表明自己自在地是什么，是精神性的本质，是绝对不安宁的运动或规定，它们直接在自己的对立面中扬弃自己。
它们的本质，即简单的意识，所以就是绝对差别的简单性，而这差别直接就不是差别。
它由此就是纯粹的自为存在，不是这个个别者的自为存在，而是自身内普遍的自我，作为不安宁的运动，它侵袭并穿透事情平静的本质。
在它里面，所以就有那种直接把自己知为真理的确定性，有纯粹思维作为绝对概念，存在于其否定性的威力之中，这种威力消灭一切对象性的、应当与意识相对而立的东西，并把它变成意识的一种存在。
——这种纯粹意识同时同样也是简单的，因为它的差别恰恰不是差别。
但作为这种简单的自身反思的形式，它就是信仰的要素，在信仰中精神具有肯定的普遍性、自在存在的规定性，以与自我意识的那种自为存在相对。
——精神从那种无本质的、只消解自身的世界中被逼回自身之内，按真理来说，就在不可分离的统一中既是它显现的绝对运动和否定性，又是它自身内得到满足的本质和它肯定的安宁。
但因为它整个儿处在异化的规定性之下，这两个环节就作为双重的意识而分开。
前者是纯粹识见，作为在自我意识中聚集起来的精神过程，它把肯定东西的意识、对象性或表象的形式作为对立面，并针对它而行动；但它自己的对象只是纯粹的自我。
——反之，肯定东西的简单意识，或平静的自身等同，则以内在本质为对象。
所以纯粹识见最初在自身那里没有内容，因为它是否定的自为存在；反之，信仰则拥有内容，却没有识见。
如果前者不走出自我意识，那么后者虽然同样在纯粹自我意识的要素里有它的内容，但却是在思维里，不是在概念里，是在纯粹意识里，不是在纯粹自我意识里。
它由此虽然是本质、即简单的内在东西的纯粹意识，因而就是思维——这是信仰本性中的主要环节，通常却被忽略。
本质在它里面所处的那种直接性，就在于它的对象是本质，即纯粹思想。
但这种直接性，只要思维进入意识、或纯粹意识进入自我意识，就获得一种对象性存在的含义，这种存在处在自我的意识之外。
正是通过纯粹思维的直接性和简单性在意识里获得的这种含义，信仰的本质才从思维中落到表象里，变成一个超感性世界，这个世界本质上是自我意识的他者。
——反之，在纯粹识见里，纯粹思维向意识的过渡却具有相反的规定；对象性具有这样一种含义，即它只是一个否定的、扬弃自身并回到自我中去的内容，也就是说，只有自我才真正是自己的对象，或者对象只有在具有自我的形式时才有真理。

en: As faith and pure insight belong in common to the element of pure consciousness, so they are also in common the return out of the actual world of culture.
They therefore present themselves according to three sides.

At one time each is, outside all relation, in and for itself; at another time each relates itself to the actual world opposed to pure consciousness; and thirdly each relates itself within pure consciousness to the other.
zh: 信仰和纯粹识见既然共同属于纯粹意识这一要素，它们也就共同是从教养的现实世界返回。
因此它们从三个方面呈现出来。
一方面，每一个都处在一切关系之外，自在自为；另一方面，每一个都同与纯粹意识相对立的现实世界发生关系；第三，每一个都在纯粹意识之内同另一个发生关系。

en: The side of being-in-and-for-itself in the believing consciousness is its absolute object, whose content and determination have emerged.
For according to the concept of faith it is nothing other than the real world raised into the universality of pure consciousness.

The articulation of the latter therefore also constitutes the organization of the former, only that the parts in the former do not become estranged in their animation, but are essences existing in and for themselves, spirits returned into themselves and remaining at home with themselves.

The movement of their transition is therefore only for us an estrangement of the determinacy in which they are in their difference, and only for us a necessary series; but for faith their difference is a tranquil diversity and their movement a happening.
zh: 信仰的意识中自在自为存在的那一面，就是它的绝对对象，这个对象的内容和规定已经产生出来了。
因为按照信仰的概念，它无非是提高到纯粹意识之普遍性中的实在世界。
所以后者的划分也就构成前者的组织，只是在前者中，那些部分并不在它们的赋灵中异化自己，而是自在自为存在着的本质，是返回于自身、并且停留在自身那里的精神。
因此它们过渡的运动，只是对我们来说才是它们在其中处于差别中的那种规定性的异化，也只是对我们来说才是一条必然的序列；但对信仰来说，它们的差别是一种安静的差异，它们的运动是一种发生。

en: To name them briefly according to the external determination of their form: just as in the world of culture state power or the good was the first, so here too the first is the absolute essence, the spirit existing in and for itself, insofar as it is the simple eternal substance.

But in the realization of its concept, of being spirit, it passes over into being for another; its self-equality becomes the actual, self-sacrificing absolute essence; it becomes a self, but a transient self.
Hence the third is the return of this estranged self and of the humbled substance into its first simplicity; only in this way is it represented as spirit.
zh: 按照它们形式的外在规定简短地称呼它们，那么，正如在教养的世界里国家权力或善是第一位的东西，这里第一位的东西也是绝对本质、自在自为存在着的精神，只要它是那单纯的永恒实体。
但在它实现自己的概念、即成为精神的过程中，它却过渡为为他存在；它的自身等同变成现实的、自我牺牲着的绝对本质；它变成一个自我，但只是一个消逝着的自我。
因此第三个环节就是这个异化了的自我和被贬低的实体返回到它的最初单纯性；只有以这种方式，它才被表象为精神。

en: These differentiated essences, drawn back into themselves out of the transition of the actual world through thought, are unchanging eternal spirits whose being is to think the unity that they constitute.
Thus removed from self-consciousness, these essences nevertheless reach into it; if the essence were unmoved in the form of the first simple substance, it would remain foreign to it.

But the externalization of this substance and then its spirit has in it the moment of actuality and thereby makes itself partaker of the believing self-consciousness, or the believing consciousness belongs to the real world.
zh: 这些有区别的本质，通过思维而从现实世界的变化中被收回于自身，它们是不变易的永恒精神，它们的存在就是去思维它们所构成的那个统一。
这样一些本质虽然被挪到了自我意识之外，却仍然干预到自我意识之中；如果本质一动不动地停留在最初那个单纯实体的形式里，它就会对自我意识保持陌生。
但这个实体的外化、随后还有它的精神，在自身带有现实性这一环节，并因此使自己分享到信仰的自我意识，或者说，信仰的意识属于实在世界。

en: According to this second relation the believing consciousness has in part its own actuality in the real world of culture and constitutes its spirit and its determinate being, which has been considered; but in part it confronts this its actuality as the vain and is the movement of sublating it.

This movement does not consist in its having a clever consciousness about its inversion; for it is the simple consciousness which counts the clever as vain, because the latter still has the real world as its purpose.
Rather, the actuality confronts the tranquil realm of its thought as a spirit-less determinate being, which must therefore be overcome in an external way.

This obedience of service and of praise brings forth, through the sublation of sensuous knowing and doing, the consciousness of unity with the essence existing in and for itself, yet not as an intuited actual unity; rather, this service is only the continual bringing-forth that does not completely reach its goal in the present.

The community does indeed arrive at it, for it is the universal self-consciousness; but for the single self-consciousness the realm of pure thought necessarily remains a beyond of its actuality; or, since this realm has entered actuality through the externalization of the eternal essence, it is an unconceived sensuous actuality; but one sensuous actuality remains indifferent to the other, and the beyond has merely also received the determination of distance in space and time.
— But the concept, the self-present actuality of spirit, remains in the believing consciousness the inner, which is and effects everything, but does not itself step forth.
zh: 按照这第二种关系，信仰的意识一方面在教养的实在世界里拥有它自己的现实性，并构成这个已经被考察过的世界的精神和定在；另一方面，它又作为虚无的东西与它自己的这种现实性相对立，并且是扬弃这种现实性的运动。
这种运动并不在于它对这个颠倒有一种机智的意识；因为它就是那单纯的意识，它把机智的东西算作虚无的东西，因为后者仍然把实在世界当作自己的目的。
相反，与它思想的安静王国相对立的，是一个无精神的定在，因此这个定在要以一种外在的方式去克服。
这种服务和赞颂的顺从，通过扬弃感性的知识和行动，产生出与自在自为存在着的本质相统一的意识，但不是作为被直观到的现实统一，相反，这种服务只是那持续的产出，它在当前并没有完全达到自己的目标。
教团虽然达到了这种统一，因为它是普遍的自我意识；但对单个的自我意识来说，纯粹思维的王国必然仍然是它现实性的彼岸，或者说，既然这个王国通过永恒本质的外化进入了现实性，它就是一种未被以概念把握的感性现实性；而一种感性现实性对另一种感性现实性始终保持无差别，彼岸由此只还得到空间和时间中的距离这一规定。
——但概念，即精神自己呈现给自己的现实性，在信仰的意识中仍然是内在的东西，它是一切并且起一切作用，但不自己显露出来。

en: In pure insight, however, the concept is the alone actual; and this third side of faith, to be an object for pure insight, is the proper relation in which it appears here.

— Pure insight itself is likewise to be considered partly in and for itself, partly in relation to the actual world, insofar as it is still present as positive, namely as vain consciousness, and partly finally in that relation to faith.
zh: 但在纯粹识见中，概念是唯一现实的东西；而信仰的第三个方面，即成为纯粹识见的对象，就是它在这里出现于其中的真正关系。
——纯粹识见本身同样要一部分自在地和自为地来考察，一部分在它还与现实世界的关系中、只要它还作为肯定的东西、即作为虚无的意识而存在，最后一部分则要在它与信仰的那种关系中来考察。

en: What pure insight is in and for itself, we have seen; as faith is the tranquil pure consciousness of spirit as of the essence, so it is the self-consciousness of the same; it therefore knows the essence not as essence, but as absolute self.
It therefore aims at sublating all self-sufficiency other than self-consciousness, whether of the actual or of what exists in itself, and at making it into the concept.
It is not only the certainty of self-conscious reason to be all truth; rather, it knows that it is this.
zh: 纯粹识见自在自为是什么，我们已经看到了；正如信仰是精神作为本质的安静纯粹意识，纯粹识见则是精神的自我意识；因此它并不把本质认作本质，而是认作绝对自我。
所以它力求扬弃一切对自我意识而言的别的独立性，无论是现实东西的独立性还是自在存在者的独立性，并把它们变成概念。
它不只是自我意识到的理性具有一切真理这种确定性；相反，它知道它就是这一点。

en: But as the concept of the same appears, it is not yet realized.
Its consciousness accordingly still appears as a contingent, single one, and what is the essence for it appears as a purpose that it has to actualize.
It has at first the intention to make pure insight universal, i.e. to make everything that is actual into the concept, and into one concept in all self-consciousnesses.

The intention is pure, for it has pure insight as its content; and this insight is likewise pure, for its content is only the absolute concept, which has no opposition in an object, nor is limited in itself.

In the unrestricted concept there lie immediately the two sides: that everything objective has only the meaning of being-for-itself, of self-consciousness, and that this has the meaning of a universal — that pure insight becomes the property of all self-consciousnesses.

This second side of the intention is to that extent a result of culture, in that therein, as the differences of objective spirit, the parts and judgment-determinations of its world, so also the differences which appear as originally determined natures, have perished.

Genius, talent, the particular capacities in general, belong to the world of actuality insofar as it still has on it the side of being a spiritual animal kingdom, which in mutual violence and confusion fights and cheats over the essences of the real world.
— The differences indeed have no place in it as honest species; neither does individuality content itself with the unreal matter itself, nor does it have particular content and its own purposes.

Rather, it counts only as something universally valid, namely as something formed; and the difference reduces itself to the lesser or greater energy — a difference of magnitude, i.e. the unessential one.
But this last diversity has perished in this: that the difference in the complete tornness of consciousness turned into the absolutely qualitative.
What in this is the other for the I is only the I itself.

In this infinite judgment all one-sidedness and peculiarity of the original being-for-itself is erased; the self knows itself, as pure self, to be its object; and this absolute equality of both sides is the element of pure insight.
— It is therefore the simple essence undifferentiated in itself, and likewise the universal work and universal possession.

In this simple spiritual substance self-consciousness gives and maintains itself in every object just as much as the consciousness of this its singleness or of the doing, as conversely the individuality of the same is therein self-equal and universal.
— This pure insight is therefore the spirit that calls out to all consciousness: be for yourselves what you all are in yourselves — rational.
zh: 但纯粹识见的概念出现时，它还没有被实现。
因此它的意识这时还显现为一种偶然的、单个的意识，而它认作本质的东西则显现为一个它要去实现的目的。
它起初的意图是使纯粹识见成为普遍的，即把一切现实的东西都变成概念，并且在一切自我意识中变成同一个概念。
这个意图是纯粹的，因为它以纯粹识见为内容；而这种识见同样是纯粹的，因为它的内容只是绝对概念，这个概念在对象上没有对立面，它本身也不受限制。
在不受限制的概念里，直接包含着两个方面：一切对象性的东西只有自为存在、自我意识这一含义，而这个东西则具有普遍者的含义，即纯粹识见成为一切自我意识的财产。
意图的这第二个方面就此而言是教养的结果，因为在教养中，客观精神的那些差别、即它的世界的各个部分和判断规定，以及那些显得是源初被规定的本性的差别，都已消亡了。
天才、才能、一般的特殊能力，都属于现实性的世界，只要这个世界在自身还带有精神动物王国这一面，而精神动物王国在相互的暴力与混乱中为着实在世界的本质而互相争斗、互相欺骗。
——那些差别在这里诚然没有作为诚实的种的地位；个体性既不以那非现实的事情本身为满足，也不具有特殊的内容和自己的目的。
相反，它只被看作一种普遍有效的东西，即被看作受过教养的东西；而差别则归结为较少或较多的能量，——一种量的差别，也就是非本质的差别。
但这最后的差异已经消亡于这一点：在意识完全撕裂的状态中，差别翻转成了绝对质的差别。
在这里对自我来说是他者的东西，只是自我本身。
在这个无限的判断中，源初自为存在的一切片面性和特有性都被抹掉了；自我知道自己是纯粹自我，知道自己是自己的对象；而这两方面的绝对平等就是纯粹识见的要素。
——因此它就是那单纯地自身内无差别的本质，同样也是那普遍的作品和普遍的财产。
在这种单纯的精神实体里，自我意识在一切对象中都同样给出并保持这种对它自己的个别性或对行动的意识，反过来，它的个体性在其中也是自身等同的、普遍的。
——所以这种纯粹识见就是那个向一切意识呼喊的精神：你们就自为地是你们大家自在所是的东西吧，——即理性的东西。

en: The peculiar object against which pure insight directs the force of the concept is faith, as the form of pure consciousness that stands over against it in the same element.

But it also has reference to the actual world, for like faith it is the return out of that world into pure consciousness; it is first to be seen how its activity is constituted with respect to the impure intentions and perverted insights of that world.
zh: 纯粹识见把概念的力对准的那个特有的对象，就是信仰，即在同一元素中与它相对而立的纯粹意识的形式。
但它也与现实世界有关系，因为它和信仰一样是从现实世界返回纯粹意识，首先必须看看，它是如何针对现实世界的那些不纯意图和颠倒识见而行动的。

en: The calm consciousness was already mentioned above, which stands over against this vortex that dissolves itself in itself and generates itself again; it makes up the side of pure insight and intention.

But into this calm consciousness, as we saw, there falls no particular insight into the world of culture; rather, this world itself has the most painful feeling and the truest insight about itself – the feeling of being, through the dissolution of everything that fixes itself, racked through all the moments of its determinate being and shattered in all its bones; likewise it is the language of this feeling and the judging, ingenious discourse about all sides of its condition.

Pure insight can therefore have here no activity and content of its own, and can thus comport itself only as the formal, faithful apprehension of this world's own ingenious insight and of its language.

Since this language is scattered, the judging a drivel of the moment that immediately forgets itself again, and a whole only for a third consciousness, this consciousness as pure insight can distinguish itself only by gathering those scattering traits into a universal picture and then making them into an insight of all.
zh: 前面已经提到过那种平静的意识，它与这个在自身中消解又再生的漩涡相对而立；它构成纯粹识见和意图这一方面。
但是，正如我们看到的，落进这种平静意识里的，并不是关于教养世界的什么特殊识见；相反，教养世界本身有着最痛苦的感情和关于它自己的最真的识见——这种感觉就是：一切自身固定化的东西都在消解，而它自己被透过它定在的一切环节上了轮刑、在所有的骨头上被打碎；同样，它也是这种感觉的语言，是关于它状况的一切方面的、作出评判的机智言谈。
所以，纯粹识见在这里不能有自己的活动和内容，因而只能作为对这种世界自身的机智识见及其语言所作的形式上的忠实领会来行事。
由于这种语言是分散的，评判是一时一刻的胡言乱语、马上又把自己忘掉，而整体只是为着一个第三意识而存在，所以这个意识作为纯粹识见只能靠这一点来区别自己：把那些分散开去的特征汇集为一幅普遍的图像，然后把它们变成所有人共有的一种识见。

en: By this simple means it will bring the confusion of this world to dissolution.

For it has turned out that it is not the masses, and the determinate concepts and individualities, that are the essence of this actuality, but that this actuality has its substance and hold solely in the spirit that exists as judging and talking, and that the interest in having a content for this reasoning and chattering alone maintains the whole and the masses of its articulation; in this language of insight its self-consciousness is still for itself a being-for-itself, this single one, but the vanity of the content is at the same time the vanity of the self that knows it vain.

Now in that the calmly apprehending consciousness brings into a compendium the most fitting and thing-cutting formulations out of this whole ingenious chatter of vanity, there perishes, along with the remaining vanity of determinate being, the soul that still maintains the whole, the vanity of ingenious judging.

The compendium shows to most a better wit than their own, or at least to all a more manifold one, and shows knowing-better and judging in general as something universal and now universally known; thereby the only interest that was still present is wiped out, and the single insight dissolves into the universal insight.
zh: 它将通过这个简单的办法，使这个世界的混乱得到消解。
因为已经表明：并不是那些群体、那些特定的概念和个体性构成这种现实性的本质，而是说，它唯独在作为判断和谈论而存在的那种精神里才有自己的实体和支撑，并且唯独那种为了这种推理和空谈而拥有一个内容的兴趣，才维持着整体以及它划分出来的各群体，在识见的这种语言里，它的自我意识对自己来说还是一个自为存在着的、这个个别的东西，但内容的虚妄同时也就是那个知道内容虚妄的自我本身的虚妄。
现在，由于平静地领会着的意识从这种虚妄的全部机智空谈中，把那些最中肯的、切入事情的表述收集到一部汇编里，于是，随着定在其余的虚妄，那个还在维持整体的灵魂、即机智评判的虚妄，也就一同毁灭了。
这部汇编给大多数人显示出一种比他们自己的机智更好的机智，或者至少给所有人显示出一种更多样的机智，并且把自以为知道得更多和评判本身显示为某种普遍的东西、如今又普遍为人所知的东西；这样一来，那唯一还现存的兴趣就消失了，个别的识见消解为普遍的识见。

en: But above vain knowing, the knowing of the essence still stands firm, and pure insight first appears in proper activity insofar as it steps forth against faith.
zh: 但是，关于本质的知识还牢固地立于虚妄的知识之上，而纯粹识见只有在它起来反对信仰时，才第一次出现在本己的活动之中。

18.en: a. The Struggle of Enlightenment with Superstition
18.zh: a. 启蒙与迷信的斗争

en: The various modes of the negative comportment of consciousness, partly those of scepticism, partly those of theoretical and practical idealism, are subordinate shapes compared with this shape of pure insight and its propagation, enlightenment; for it is born out of the substance, knows the pure self of consciousness as absolute, and takes this self up together with the pure consciousness of the absolute essence of all actuality.

– Since faith and insight are the same pure consciousness but opposed in form – for faith, the essence as thought, not as concept, and therefore something absolutely opposed to self-consciousness; for pure insight, on the other hand, the essence is the self – they are for one another, the one, the absolutely negative of the other.

As the two step forth against each other, all content falls to faith; for in its calm element of thinking every moment gains subsistence; – pure insight, however, is at first without content and rather the pure disappearance of it; but through the negative movement against what is negative for it, it will realize itself and give itself a content.
zh: 意识那些否定性的行为方式，一部分是怀疑论，一部分是理论观念论和实践观念论，与纯粹识见及其传播、即启蒙这形态相比，都是从属的形态；因为它从实体中生出来，把意识的纯粹自我知道为绝对的，并且把这个自我和一切现实性之绝对本质的纯粹意识一起接纳下来。
——由于信仰和识见是同一个纯粹意识，但在形式上却互相对立——对信仰来说，本质是思想，不是概念，因而是一种与自我意识绝对对立的东西；对纯粹识见来说，本质则是自我——，所以它们彼此相对，一方就是另一方的绝对否定物。
当两者互相对立地出现时，一切内容都归信仰所有；因为在其平静的思维元素中，每个环节都获得持存；——但纯粹识见起初没有内容，毋宁说是内容的纯粹消失；然而通过针对对它而言的否定者所作的这种否定运动，它将使自己实在化，并给自己一个内容。

en: It knows faith as that which is opposed to it, to reason and truth.

As faith is for it in general a web of superstition, prejudices and errors, so the consciousness of this content further organizes itself for it into a realm of error, in which the false insight is present, on the one hand, as the universal mass of consciousness, immediately, ingenuously and without reflection in itself, but on the other hand has the moment of reflection-into-itself or of self-consciousness, separated from the ingenuousness, also on it as an insight and evil intention that remains for itself in the background, by which that mass is deluded.

That mass is the victim of the deception of a priesthood, which carries out its envious vanity of remaining alone in possession of insight, as well as its other self-interest, and at the same time conspires with despotism, which, as the synthetic concept-less unity of the real and this ideal realm – a strangely inconsistent being – stands above the bad insight of the crowd and the bad intention of the priests and also unites both in itself, draws, from the stupidity and confusion of the people through the means of the deceiving priesthood, while despising both, the advantage of calm domination and of the execution of its lusts and arbitrariness, but is at the same time the same dullness of insight, the same superstition and error.
zh: 它把信仰知道为与它、即与理性和真理相对立的东西。
正如信仰对它来说一般是一张由迷信、偏见和谬误织成的网，这种内容的意识进一步就为它组织成一个谬误的王国，在其中，虚假的识见一方面作为意识的普遍群体，直接地、不偏不倚地、没有反思地存在于自身之中，另一方面，它在自身上也有自身反思或自我意识的环节，即与不偏不倚分离开来的那个环节，作为在背景中自为地留存下来的识见和恶劣意图，而那群体正是被这种识见和意图所迷惑。

那群体是教士集团欺骗的牺牲品，这个教士集团施行自己那种嫉妒的虚妄，即要独自保持在识见的占有之中，并且施行它其余的私利，同时又与专制政体勾结在一起；这个专制政体作为实在的王国和这个观念的王国的那种综合的、无概念的统一——一个奇怪地不自洽的本质——，立在人群的恶劣识见和教士的恶劣意图之上，并且把两者也结合在自身之中，它从民众的愚昧和混乱出发，借助那个骗人的教士集团，在蔑视两者的同时，取得平静统治以及遂行自己的享乐和任性的好处，但同时又具有同样迟钝的识见、同样的迷信和谬误。

en: Enlightenment does not engage with these three sides of the enemy without distinction; for since its essence is pure insight, the universal in and for itself, its true relation to the other extreme is the one in which it goes for what is common and equal in both.
The side of the singleness that isolates itself out of the universal, ingenuous consciousness is what is opposed to it, which it cannot touch immediately.

The will of the deceiving priesthood and of the oppressive despot is therefore not the immediate object of its doing, but rather the will-less insight that does not individualize itself into being-for-itself, the concept of rational self-consciousness, which has its determinate being in the mass but is not yet present in it as concept.

But in that pure insight tears this honest insight and its ingenuous essence away from prejudices and errors, it wrenches out of the hands of the evil intention the reality and power of its deception, whose realm has its ground and material in the concept-less consciousness of the universal mass,
– [just as] being-for-itself has its substance in simple consciousness in general.
zh: 对于敌人的这三个方面，启蒙并不是不加区别地与之交手；因为既然它的本质是纯粹识见，即自在自为的普遍物，那么它对待另一极端的真正关系，就是那种针对两者共同的和相等的东西的关系。
那种从普遍的、不偏不倚的意识中孤立出来的个别性这一方面，是与它对立的东西，它不能直接触及。
所以，骗人的教士集团和压迫人的专制君主的意志，并不是它行动的直接对象，而毋宁是那种无意志的、并不个别化为自为存在的识见，即理性自我意识的概念，这个概念在群体那里有自己的定在，但在群体中还没有作为概念现成存在。
但是，由于纯粹识见把这种诚实的识见及其不偏不倚的本质从偏见和谬误中夺出来，它就从恶劣意图的手中扭下了它欺骗的实在性和权力，——这种欺骗的王国在普遍群体的无概念意识那里有自己的基地和材料，
——[正如]自为存在在一般简单意识那里拥有自己的实体。

en: The relation of pure insight to the ingenuous consciousness of the absolute essence now has the doubled side that, on the one hand, it is in itself the same as that consciousness, but on the other hand, that the latter, in the simple element of its thought, lets the absolute essence as well as its parts be granted and give themselves subsistence, and lets them count only as its in-itself and therefore in an objective manner, but denies its being-for-itself in this in-itself.

– Insofar as, according to the first side, this faith is in itself pure self-consciousness for pure insight, and is only to become this for itself, pure insight has, in this concept of faith, the element in which it realizes itself instead of the false insight.
zh: 纯粹识见对绝对本质的不偏不倚意识的关系，现在具有双重方面：一方面，它自在地与这种意识是同一个东西；另一方面，这种意识在其思维的简单元素中，让绝对本质及其各个部分自行存在、取得持存，而且只让它们作为它的自在、并因此以对象性的方式有效，却在自在中否认自己的自为存在。
——就第一个方面而言，这种信仰自在地对纯粹识见来说就是纯粹自我意识，并且它只应当自为地成为这种自我意识，所以纯粹识见就在信仰的这个概念上拥有了那个元素，它在其中取代虚假的识见而使自己实在化。

en: From this side, that both are essentially the same and the relation of pure insight takes place through and in the same element, its communication is an immediate one and its giving and receiving an undisturbed flowing-into-one-another.

Whatever else may further have been driven into consciousness as stakes, it is in itself this simplicity, in which everything is dissolved, forgotten and ingenuous, and which is therefore utterly receptive of the concept.
The communication of pure insight is therefore to be compared to a calm expansion, or to the spreading of a scent in a resistance-less atmosphere.
It is a penetrating infection that does not first make itself noticeable as something opposed to the indifferent element into which it insinuates itself, and can therefore not be warded off.
Only once the infection has spread is it there for the consciousness that surrendered itself to it without concern.

For what it received into itself was indeed the simple essence equal to itself and to it, but at the same time the simplicity of negativity reflected into itself, which afterwards also unfolds itself according to its nature as something opposed and thereby reminds consciousness of its previous mode; it is the concept, which is the simple knowing that knows itself and at the same time its opposite, but knows this in it as sublated.

As soon, therefore, as pure insight is there for consciousness, it has already spread; the struggle against it betrays the infection that has taken place; it comes too late, and every remedy only makes the illness worse, for it has seized the marrow of spiritual life, namely consciousness in its concept or its pure essence itself; there is therefore also no force in it that would be above it.
Because it is in the essence itself, its still isolated expressions can be pushed back and the superficial symptoms damped down.

This is most advantageous to it; for it now does not uselessly squander its force, nor does it show itself unworthy of its essence, which is the case when it breaks out into symptoms and single eruptions against the content of faith and against the coherence of its outer actuality, but now, an invisible and unnoticed spirit, it steals through and through the noble parts and has soon thoroughly taken possession of all the entrails and limbs of the unconscious idol, and ›one fine morning it gives its comrade a shove with the elbow, and bang!
Crash! the idol lies on the ground‹.

– On a fine morning whose noon is not bloody, when the infection has penetrated all the organs of spiritual life; only memory then still preserves, as a past story, one knows not how, the dead mode of the previous shape of the spirit; and the new serpent of wisdom, raised up for adoration, has in this way only sloughed off a withered skin without pain.
zh: 从这一方面看，即两者本质上同一个东西，而纯粹识见的关系是通过并且在这个同一元素中发生的，它的传达就是直接的，它的给予和接受就是一种不受干扰的彼此流入。
不管此外还在意识里钉进了什么木桩，它自在地就是这种单纯性，在它之中一切都消解了、被遗忘了、不偏不倚了，因此它完全能够接受概念。
所以，纯粹识见的传达可以比作一种平静的扩展，或者比作一种香气在毫无阻力的空气中的传播。
它是一种穿透性的传染，它并不事先作为对立的东西，对那个它悄悄潜入其中的漠不相干的元素显露出来，因此无法被抵挡。
只有当传染已经传播开来，它才为那种无忧无虑地把自己交给它的意识而存在。
因为它在自身中接受的固然是那种单纯的、既与自身相等也与它相等的本质，但同时又是自身内反思了的否定性的单纯性，这种否定性后来也按照自己的本性把自己展开为对立的东西，并由此使意识回忆起自己先前的方式；它就是概念，即那种单纯的知识，它知道自己，并且同时知道自己的反面，但知道这反面在它之中是被扬弃了的。
所以，纯粹识见一旦为意识而存在，它就已经传播开来了；针对它的斗争泄露了已经发生的传染；这斗争来得太迟，而且每一种手段都只会使疾病加重，因为它已经抓住了精神生命的骨髓，即抓住了意识在其概念中的存在、或者说意识那纯粹的本质本身；因此意识之中也没有任何力量会高过它。
由于它就在本质本身之中，它那些还个别化的表现可以被压回去，表面的症状可以被抑制。
这对它极为有利；因为它现在不再无用地浪费自己的力，也不再显得不配自己的本质，——当它针对信仰的内容、并针对信仰那外部现实性的联系而爆发为症状和个别发作时，情况就是如此——，而是作为看不见的、不被人注意的精神，彻头彻尾地潜行穿过那些高贵的部分，并且很快就彻底占有了那个无意识偶像的一切内脏和肢体，而且›在一个美好的早晨，它用胳膊肘推了同伴一下，于是砰！
哗啦！那偶像倒在地上‹。
——在一个美好的早晨，它的正午并不流血，这时传染已经穿透了精神生命的一切器官；这时只有记忆还把先前精神形态的死方式，作为一段——人们不知道怎么回事——已经过去了的历史保存下来；而那新的、为着受人崇拜而被举高的智慧之蛇，就以这种方式只是无痛地蜕去了一张枯萎的皮。

en: But this silent weaving-on of spirit in the simple inner of its substance, in which it hides its doing from itself, is only one side of the realization of pure insight.
Its spread does not consist only in like going together with like; and its realization is not only an expansion without opposition.

Rather, the doing of the negative essence is just as essentially a developed movement that distinguishes itself within itself, which, as conscious doing, must set up its moments in a determinate, manifest determinate being and must be present as a loud noise and a violent struggle with the opposed as such.
zh: 但精神在它实体的单纯内在里这种无声的继续编织，在其中它把它的行动对自己隐藏起来，只是纯粹识见的实现的一个方面。
它的传播并不只在于相同者与相同者走到一起；而它的实现也不只是一种没有对立的扩展。
相反，否定性本质的行动同样本质上是一种展开的、在自身中自我区别的运动，这种运动作为有意识的行动，必须把它的诸环节设定在确定的、公开的定在中，并且必须作为一片响亮的喧嚷和与对立者本身进行的暴力斗争而存在。

en: It is therefore to be seen how pure insight and intention comport themselves negatively toward the other opposed to them that they find before them.
– Pure insight and intention, which comport themselves negatively, can, since their concept is all essentiality and nothing outside them, be only the negative of themselves.

As insight, therefore, it becomes the negative of pure insight, it becomes untruth and unreason, and as intention it becomes the negative of pure intention, into the lie and insincerity of the purpose.
zh: 因此要看看，纯粹识见和意图如何对它们所遇到的、与它们相对立的另一个采取否定的态度。
——采取否定态度的纯粹识见和意图，既然它们的概念就是一切本质性，在它们之外别无他物，那就只能是自己本身的否定物。
因此它作为识见就成为纯粹识见的否定物，它成为非真理和非理性，而作为意图则成为纯粹意图的否定物，成为谎言和目的的不纯正。

en: It entangles itself in this contradiction by the fact that it enters into dispute and believes itself to be combating something other.

– It only believes this, for its essence as absolute negativity is this, to have otherness on itself; the absolute concept is the category; it is this, that knowing and the object of knowing are the same.
What pure insight thereby declares as its other, what it declares as error or lie, can be nothing other than itself; it can only condemn what it is.
What is not rational has no truth, or what is not comprehended is not; so when reason speaks of an other than it is, it in fact speaks only of itself; it does not step out of itself therein.
– This struggle with the opposed therefore unites in itself the meaning of being its realization.

This consists precisely in the movement of developing the moments and taking them back into itself; one part of this movement is the distinction in which comprehending insight sets itself over against itself as object; as long as it lingers in this moment, it is estranged from itself.

As pure insight it is without all content; the movement of its realization consists in this, that it itself becomes content for itself, for an other cannot become content for it, because it is the self-consciousness of the category.
But since it at first knows it in the opposing only as content and not yet as itself, it misrecognizes itself in it.
Its completion therefore has this meaning, to recognize the content that is at first objective for it as its own.

Its result, however, will thereby be neither the restoration of the errors it combats nor merely its first concept, but an insight that recognizes the absolute negation of itself as its own actuality, as itself, or its self-recognizing concept.
– This nature of the struggle of enlightenment with errors, to struggle in them against itself and to condemn therein what it asserts, is for us, or is what it and its struggle are in themselves.

But the first side of this struggle, its contamination through the admission of the negative comportment into its self-equal purity, is how it is object for faith, which therefore experiences it as lie, unreason and bad intention, just as faith is error and prejudice for it.

– In regard to its content it is at first the empty insight, to which its content appears as an other, so that it finds it, in this shape that it is not yet its own, as a determinate being wholly independent of it, in faith.
zh: 它之所以卷入这个矛盾，是因为它介入争执，以为自己是在同某种别的东西作斗争。
——它只是以为这样，因为它作为绝对否定性的本质就在于在它自己身上拥有他在，绝对概念就是范畴；它就是这一点：知识和知识的对象是同一个东西。
由此，纯粹识见宣布为它的他者的东西，它宣布为错误或谎言的东西，只能是它自己；它只能谴责它所是的东西。
不理性的东西没有真理，或者，没有被以概念把握的东西不存在；所以，当理性谈到一个不同于它自己的他者时，它实际上只是在谈它自己；它在此并没有走出自身。
——所以，与对立者的这场斗争自身就含有这样的含义：成为它的实现。
这种实现恰恰就在于展开诸环节并把它们收回自身的运动；这一运动的一部分是区别，在区别中，以概念把握着的识见把自己作为对象与自己对立起来；只要它停留在这个环节里，它就是自身异化了的。
作为纯粹识见，它没有任何内容，它实现自己的运动就在于：它自己成为自己的内容，因为另一个东西不能成为它的内容，因为它就是范畴的自我意识。
但既然它在设定对立时最初只把这个内容认作内容，还没有把它认作它自己，它就在这个内容中认错了自己。
因此，它的完成有这样的含义：把最初对它是对象性的内容认作它自己的内容。
但它的结果由此既不是它与之作斗争的那些错误的恢复，也不只是它最初的概念，而是一种识见，这种识见把对它自身的绝对否定认作它自己的现实性、认作它自己，或者说，是它自己认识自己的概念。
——启蒙同错误所作的这场斗争，其本性就是在错误中同自己作斗争，并且谴责自己在此所主张的东西，这是对我们而言的，或者说，是启蒙和它的斗争自在所是的东西。
但这场斗争的第一个方面，即它由于把否定的态度接纳进它自身等同的纯粹性而受到的污染，就是它在信仰看来成为对象的样子，而信仰因此把它经验为谎言、非理性和坏意图，正如信仰对它来说是错误和偏见一样。
——就它的内容来看，它首先是空洞的识见，对它来说它的内容显现为另一个东西，因此它以这样的形态，即内容还不是它自己的这一形态，把这个内容当作一个完全独立于它的定在来发现，这个定在就在信仰中。

en: Enlightenment therefore at first and in general comprehends its object in such a way that it takes it as pure insight and, not knowing itself, declares it to be error.

In insight as such, consciousness comprehends an object in such a way that it becomes for it the essence of consciousness or an object that it penetrates, in which it maintains itself, remains at home with itself and present to itself, and, since it is thereby its movement, brings it forth.

As precisely this, enlightenment correctly expresses faith in saying of it that what is the absolute essence for it is a being of its own consciousness, its own thought, something brought forth by consciousness.
It thereby declares it to be error and fabrication about the very thing that it is.

– It, which wants to teach faith the new wisdom, says nothing new to it thereby; for its object is for it precisely this too, namely the pure essence of its own consciousness, so that this consciousness therein does not posit itself as lost and negated, but rather trusts it, that is, precisely therein finds itself as this consciousness or as self-consciousness.
Whomever I trust, his certainty of himself is for me the certainty of myself; I recognize my being-for-me in him, that he recognizes it and that it is purpose and essence for him.
Trust, however, is faith, because its consciousness relates itself immediately to its object and therefore also intuits this, that it is one with it, is in it.

– Further, since that in which I recognize myself is object for me, I am therein at the same time generally for myself as another self-consciousness, that is, as one that has therein been estranged from its particular singleness, namely from its naturalness and contingency, but in part remains therein self-consciousness, in part is therein precisely essential consciousness like pure insight.

– In the concept of insight there lies not only this, that consciousness recognizes itself in its insight-pervaded object and, without leaving the thought and first going back from it into itself, has itself immediately therein, but it is conscious of itself as also of the mediating movement, or of itself as of the doing or producing; thereby in the thought there is for it this unity of itself as the self and of the object.
– This very consciousness is also faith; obedience and doing is a necessary moment through which the certainty of being in the absolute essence comes about.
This doing of faith does not indeed appear in such a way that the absolute essence itself would thereby be brought forth.

But the absolute essence of faith is essentially not the abstract essence that would be beyond the believing consciousness, but it is the spirit of the community, it is the unity of the abstract essence and of self-consciousness.

That it is this spirit of the community, therein the doing of the community is an essential moment; it is this only through the producing of consciousness, – or rather, not without having been brought forth by consciousness; for however essential the producing is, it is just as essentially not the sole ground of the essence, but only a moment.
The essence is at the same time in and for itself.
zh: 所以，启蒙最初并且一般地这样理解它的对象：把它当作纯粹识见，并在不认识自己的情况下把它宣布为错误。
在作为这样的识见中，意识这样把握一个对象：这个对象对它来说成为意识的本质，或者成为一个它所贯穿的对象，意识在这个对象中保持自己、安于自身并且当下在场，而由于它由此就是自己的运动，它就把这个对象产生出来。
正是作为这一点，启蒙正确地表述了信仰，因为它说，对它来说是绝对本质的那个东西，是它自己意识的一种存在，是它自己的思想，是由意识产生出来的东西。
它由此就把信仰宣布为关于它自己所是的那个东西的错误和虚构。
——它想把新智慧教给信仰，这样说并没有告诉信仰什么新东西；因为它的对象对它来说恰恰也是这一点，即它自己意识的纯粹本质，以致这个意识在其中并没有把自己设定为丧失了的和被否定了的，反而对它抱有信任，也就是说，正是在其中把自己认作这个意识或自我意识。
我信任谁，他对自己本身的确定性就是我对自己的确定性；我在他身上认识到我的为我存在，因为他承认它，并且它对他来说就是目的和本质。
但信任就是信仰，因为它的意识直接与它的对象相关，因而也直观到这一点：它与对象是一体的，就在对象之中。
——其次，既然那个我在其中认识到我自己的东西对我是对象，那么我在其中同时一般地就对我自己来说是一个别的自我意识，也就是说，是这样一个自我意识：它在这里已经被异化于自己特殊的个别性，也就是自己的自然性和偶然性，但它在这里一部分仍然是自我意识，一部分恰恰在这里是像纯粹识见那样的本质的意识。
——在识见的概念里不仅包含着这一点：意识在它所识见的对象中认识自己，并且不离开被思维的东西、不首先从它返回自身，而是直接就在其中拥有自己；而且还包含着：它意识到自己，也意识到中介着的运动，或者说意识到自己就是行动或产生；由此，在思想中，对它来说就有了它作为自我和作为对象的这种统一。
——正是这种意识也是信仰；顺从和行动是一个必要的环节，在绝对本质中存在的确定性就是通过这个环节产生出来的。
信仰的这种行动诚然并不显得是绝对本质本身会由此被产生出来。
但信仰的绝对本质本质上并不是那个在信仰的意识彼岸的抽象本质，而是教团的精神，是抽象本质和自我意识的统一。
它就是这个教团的精神，这一点就在于，教团的行动是一个本质性的环节；它只有通过意识的产生才是这个精神，——或者更确切地说，并非不是被意识产生出来的；因为产生虽然如此本质，它同样不是本质的唯一根据，而只是一个环节。
这个本质同时是自在自为的。

en: On the other side, the concept of pure insight is to itself an other than its object; for precisely this negative determination constitutes the object.
Thus from the other side it also declares the essence of faith to be something foreign to self-consciousness, which is not its essence but has been foisted upon it as a changeling.

But enlightenment is here utterly foolish; faith experiences it as a speaking that does not know what it says and does not understand the matter when it talks of priestcraft and deception of the people.

It speaks of this as if, by a hocus-pocus of the juggling priests, something absolutely foreign and other were foisted upon consciousness in place of the essence, and at the same time it says that this is an essence of consciousness, that consciousness believes in it, trusts it and seeks to make it well-disposed toward itself, – that is, that in it consciousness beholds its pure essence just as much as its single and universal individuality, and through its doing brings forth this unity of itself with its essence.
It immediately declares as the most proper element of consciousness that which it declares to be something foreign to consciousness.
– How then can it speak of fraud and deception?
In that it itself directly declares of faith the opposite of what it asserts about faith, it shows itself to faith rather as the conscious lie.

How are deception and fraud to take place where consciousness in its truth immediately has the certainty of itself, where it possesses itself in its object, since it equally finds itself therein and brings itself forth therein?
The difference is no longer present even in the words.

– If the general question has been posed whether it is permissible to deceive a people, then the answer would in fact have to be that the question is worthless, because it is impossible to deceive a people in this matter.

– Brass instead of gold, counterfeit bills of exchange instead of genuine ones, may well be sold singly, a lost battle may be palmed off on several people as a won one, and other lies about supersensuous things and single occurrences may be made credible for a time; but in the knowledge of the essence, in which consciousness has the immediate certainty of itself, the thought of deception falls away entirely.
zh: 从另一方面看，纯粹识见的概念对它自己来说是一个不同于它的对象的东西；因为正是这种否定性的规定构成了对象。
所以它从另一方面也就把信仰的本质说成某种对自我意识来说陌生的东西，这东西不是自我意识的本质，而是作为一个掉包儿被硬塞给它的。
不过启蒙在这里完全是愚蠢的；信仰把它经验为一种言谈，这种言谈不知道自己在说什么，并且在它谈到教士行骗和蒙骗民众时并不理解这件事。
它谈到这件事时，就好像通过耍把戏的教士们的一场戏法，某种绝对陌生的、他者的东西被当作本质硬塞给了意识，而它同时又说这是意识的一个本质，说意识相信它、信任它，并设法使它对自己有好感，——也就是说，意识在其中既直观到自己纯粹的本质，又直观到自己个别的和普遍的个体性，并且通过自己的行动产生出自己与自己本质的这种统一。
它直接把它所宣告为对意识来说陌生的那个东西，宣告为意识最固有的东西。
——那它又怎么能谈行骗和蒙骗呢？
由于它自己就直接说出与它关于信仰所断言的东西相反的话，它反倒向信仰显出自己是有意识的谎言。
在那里意识于自己的真理中直接具有对自身的确定性，在那里它在自己的对象中拥有自己本身，因为它在这对象中既找到自己也产生自己，蒙骗和行骗又怎么会在那里发生呢？
这种差别甚至在字面上也已经不存在了。
——如果人们提出那个一般的问题，即可不可以蒙骗一个民族，那么实际上答案就必定是，这个问题毫无价值，因为在这方面不可能蒙骗一个民族。
——黄铜冒充金子、假汇票冒充真汇票，也许可以零星地卖出去，一场败仗可以被硬说成胜仗而蒙过一些人，关于超感性之物和个别事件的其他谎言也可以在一段时间里被人信以为真；但在关于本质的知识中，意识在其中直接具有对自身的确定性，蒙骗的念头就完全消失了。

en: Let us see further how faith experiences enlightenment in the distinct moments of its consciousness, to which the view just indicated referred only in general.

But these moments are pure thinking, or, as object, the absolute essence in and for itself; then its relation – as a knowing – to that essence, the ground of its faith, and finally its relation to it in its doing, or its service.
As pure insight has in general misrecognized and disavowed itself in faith, so in these moments it will likewise conduct itself in a perverted way.
zh: 我们再往下看，信仰在它意识的各种不同环节中是如何经验启蒙的，而前面指出的那种看法起初还只是一般地针对这些环节。
但这些环节是纯粹思维，或者说，作为对象来看，是自在自为的绝对本质；然后是它——作为一种知识——对这本质的关联，即它的信仰的根据，最后是它在自己的行动中与这本质的关联，或者说它的侍奉。
正如纯粹识见在信仰中一般而言认错并否认了自己，它在这些环节中也会同样颠倒地行事。

en: Pure insight relates itself negatively to the absolute essence of believing consciousness.

This essence is pure thinking, and pure thinking posited within itself as object or as the essence; in believing consciousness this in-itself of thinking at the same time receives, for the consciousness that is for itself, the form, but also only the empty form, of objectivity; it is in the determination of something represented.
But to pure insight, since it is pure consciousness on the side of the self that is for itself, the other appears as a negative of self-consciousness.
This could still be taken either as the pure in-itself of thinking or also as the being of sense-certainty.
But since it is at the same time for the self, and this self, as a self that has an object, is actual consciousness, its proper object as such is an existent common thing of sense-certainty.
This object of it appears to it in faith's representation.
It condemns this representation and in it its own object.
But against faith it already commits the injustice of taking its object in such a way that it is its own.

Accordingly it says of faith that its absolute essence is a piece of stone, a block of wood that has eyes and does not see, or also a bit of bread dough which, having grown in the field, is transformed by men and sent back there, – or in whatever other ways faith anthropomorphizes the essence, makes it objective and represents it.
zh: 纯粹识见对信仰着的意识的绝对本质采取否定性的态度。
这个本质是纯粹思维，而纯粹思维是在它自身之内被设定为对象或设定为本质的；在信仰着的意识中，思维的这个自在同时为自为着的意识取得了形式，但也只是对象性那空洞的形式；它处于被表象之物的规定之中。
但对纯粹识见来说，既然它是自为着的自我这一方面的纯粹意识，他者就显现为自我意识的一个否定物。
这还可以要么被看作思维纯粹的自在，要么也被看作感性确定性的存在。
但由于它同时是为自我的，而这个自我作为拥有对象的自我又是现实的意识，所以纯粹识见的固有对象本身就是一个存在着的、属于感性确定性的普通之物。
纯粹识见的这个对象在信仰的表象那里向它显现出来。
它谴责这种表象，并在其中谴责它自己的对象。
但它对信仰的不义已经在于，它把信仰的对象把握成它自己的对象。
因此它关于信仰说，信仰的绝对本质是一块石头、一块有眼而看不见的木头，或者也是一块面团，这面团在田里长出来，被人改变之后又被送回到那里，——或者无论信仰还用哪些别的方式把本质拟人化，把它弄成对象性的并加以表象。

en: Enlightenment, which gives itself out as the pure, here turns what is eternal life and holy spirit to the spirit into an actual, transitory thing and besmirches it with the in-itself null view of sense-certainty – with a view that is not present at all in worshiping faith, so that it simply lies this view on to faith.
What it reveres is for it by no means stone or wood or bread dough, nor any other temporal sensuous thing.

If it occurs to enlightenment to say that its object is this too, or even that it is this in itself and in truth, then on the one hand faith likewise knows that “too”, but it is for it outside its adoration; on the other hand, however, such a thing as a stone and so on is not in itself for it at all, but in itself for it is solely the essence of pure thinking.
zh: 自命为纯粹东西的启蒙，在这里把对精神来说是永恒生命和神圣精神的东西变成一个现实的、会消逝的物，并且用感性确定性那种自在地毫无价值的看法来玷污它，——这种看法在崇拜着的信仰那里根本不存在，所以启蒙纯粹是撒谎把它栽给信仰的。
它所崇拜的东西，对它来说完全不是石头、木头或面团，也不是别的什么时间性的感性之物。
如果启蒙想起要说，它的对象毕竟也是这东西，甚至说它自在地并且在真理中就是这东西，那么一方面信仰同样知道那个“也是”，但这在它那里是处于它的崇拜之外的；另一方面，像石头之类的东西对它来说根本不是自在的，对它来说自在地存在的只是纯粹思维的本质。

en: The second moment is the relation of faith, as knowing consciousness, to this essence.
As thinking, pure consciousness, this essence is immediate to it; but pure consciousness is just as much a mediated relation of certainty to truth, a relation that constitutes the ground of faith.
For enlightenment, this ground likewise becomes a contingent knowledge of contingent occurrences.

But the ground of knowing is the knowing universal, and in its truth the absolute spirit, which in abstract pure consciousness or in thinking as such is only absolute essence, but as self-consciousness is the knowledge of itself.
Pure insight likewise posits this knowing universal, the simple spirit that knows itself, as the negative of self-consciousness.

It is indeed itself the pure mediated, that is, self-mediating thinking, it is pure knowing; but since it is pure insight, pure knowing, that does not yet know itself, that is, for which it is not yet the case that it is this pure mediating movement, it appears to it, like everything that it itself is, as an other.

Comprehended, then, in its realization, it develops this essential moment of its own, but this appears to it as belonging to faith and, in its determinacy, as something external to it, as a contingent knowledge of just such commonly actual stories.

It therefore imputes to religious faith that its certainty is grounded on a few individual historical testimonies, which, considered as historical testimonies, would admittedly not grant the degree of certainty about their content that newspaper reports give us about any occurrence; that its certainty further rests on the chance preservation of these testimonies, preservation through paper on the one hand and on the other through the skill and honesty of transmission from one paper to another, and finally on the correct grasp of the sense of dead words and letters.

In fact, however, it does not occur to faith to tie its certainty to such testimonies and contingencies; in its certainty it is an unprejudiced relation to its absolute object, a pure knowledge of it, which does not mix letters, paper and copyists into its consciousness of the absolute essence and does not mediate itself with it through such things.

Rather, this consciousness is the self-mediating ground of its knowing; it is spirit itself, which, in the interior of the individual consciousness as well as through the universal presence of the faith of all in it, is the testimony of itself.

If faith also wants to take from the historical that manner of grounding, or at least of confirming, its content of which enlightenment speaks, and seriously means and does so as if it mattered, then it has already let itself be seduced by enlightenment; and its efforts to ground or fortify itself in such a way are only testimonies that it gives of its infection.
zh: 第二个环节是信仰作为知道着的意识对这个本质的关系。
作为思维着的、纯粹的意识，这个本质对信仰来说是直接的；但纯粹意识同样是确定性对真理的被中介的关系，这种关系构成了信仰的根据。
这个根据对启蒙来说同样变成了一种关于偶然事件的偶然知识。
但知识的根据是知道着的普遍者，在它的真理中则是绝对精神，而绝对精神在抽象的纯粹意识中、或在思维本身中只是绝对本质，但作为自我意识则是关于自身的知识。
纯粹识见同样把这个知道着的普遍者、这个单纯地知道着自己的精神，设定为自我意识的否定物。
它虽然本身就是纯粹被中介的、也就是自己与自己中介的思维，它就是纯粹的知识；但正因为它作为纯粹识见、纯粹的知识还没有知道自己，也就是说，对它来说它还不是这种纯粹中介着的运动，所以它就像它自己所是的一切那样，对它显现为一个他者。
所以，如果从概念上把握它的实现，它就展开它这个本质的环节，但这个环节对它显现为属于信仰的，并且在它的规定性中显现为对它来说外在的东西，显现为关于恰好这样一些普通现实的故事的偶然知识。
所以它在这里诬称宗教的信仰：它的确定性建立在一些个别的历史见证上，而这些见证作为历史见证来看，对于它们的内容诚然不会给出报纸关于某件事变的消息所给我们的那种程度的确定性；它的确定性还建立在保管这些见证的偶然性上——一方面通过纸张来保管，另一方面通过把一张纸转抄到另一张纸上的技巧和诚实来保管——，最后建立在对话语和字母的死意思的正确领会之上。
但实际上，信仰根本不会想到把自己的确定性系于这样的见证和偶然性上；信仰在自己的确定性中是对它的绝对对象的一种无成见的关系，是关于这个对象的一种纯粹知识，这种知识不会把字母、纸张和抄写者混进它对绝对本质的意识里，也不会通过这类事物使自己与绝对本质中介起来。
相反，这种意识是它自己知识的那种自己中介着的根据；它就是精神本身，它在个别意识的内部、也在一切人对它的信仰的普遍在场中，都是关于自身的见证。
如果信仰也想从历史的东西中为自己取得启蒙所说的那种对自己的内容进行论证、或至少加以确证的方式，并且认真地这样认为、这样做，就好像事情取决于此，那么它就已经让自己受了启蒙的引诱；而它以这种方式来论证自己或加强自己的那些努力，只是它为自身所受的传染给出的见证。

en: The third side still remains, the relation of consciousness to the absolute essence as a doing.

This doing is the sublating of the particularity of the individual, or of the natural mode of its being-for-itself, from which the certainty arises for it that, as pure self-consciousness according to its doing, that is, as a being-for-itself singular consciousness, it is one with the essence.

– Since in doing, purposiveness and purpose are distinguished, and pure insight likewise behaves negatively in relation to this doing and, as in the other moments, disavows itself, it must, with regard to purposiveness, present itself as unintelligence, in that insight, combined with intention, finds the agreement of purpose and means to appear to it as something other, indeed as the opposite; – but with regard to purpose [it must] make evil, enjoyment and possession into the purpose and thereby prove itself to be the most impure intention, in that the pure intention, likewise as other, is impure intention.
zh: 还剩下第三个方面，即意识对绝对本质的关系，作为一种行动。
这种行动是对个体的特殊性、或对个体自为存在的自然方式的扬弃，由此对它产生出这样的确定性：按照它的行动，它作为纯粹的自我意识，也就是说，作为自为存在的个别意识，与本质是同一的。
——由于在行动上合目的性和目的被区别开来，而纯粹识见同样在针对这种行动的关系中采取否定的态度，并且像在其它环节中那样否认自己，所以它在合目的性方面必定表现为无理智，因为在与意图相联结的情况下，目的和手段的一致对它来说显现为他物、甚至是反面，——但在目的方面，[它]则必定把恶、享受和占有当作目的，并由此证明自己是最不纯粹的意图，因为纯粹意图同样作为他物就是不纯粹的意图。

en: Accordingly, with regard to purposiveness, we see enlightenment finding it foolish when the believing individual gives itself the higher consciousness of not being fettered to natural enjoyment and pleasure by really denying itself natural enjoyment and pleasure and proving by the deed that it does not lie about its contempt for them, but that this contempt is true.

– Likewise it finds it foolish that the individual absolves itself from its determinacy of being absolutely singular, excluding all others and possessing property, by itself relinquishing its property; whereby it shows in truth that it is not in earnest about its isolating, but that it is raised above the natural necessity of singularizing itself and, in this absolute singularization of being-for-itself, of disavowing the others as the same as itself.

– Pure insight finds both to be as purposeless as it is wrong, purposeless, in order to prove oneself free of pleasure and possession, to deny oneself pleasure and give away a possession; it will therefore on the contrary declare him a fool who, in order to eat, takes up the means of really eating.

– It also finds it wrong to deny oneself a meal and to give away butter, eggs not in exchange for money, or money not in exchange for butter and eggs, but straight away, without receiving anything of the sort in return; it declares a meal or the possession of such things to be an end in itself and thereby in fact declares itself to be a very impure intention, for which such enjoyment and possession is wholly essential.

As pure intention it also again asserts the necessity of rising above natural existence and above greed for its means; only it finds it foolish and wrong that this rising should be proved by the deed, or this pure intention is in truth a deception, which pretends and demands an inward rising, but declares making it earnest, really putting it into work and proving its truth, to be superfluous, foolish and even wrong.

Thus it disavows itself both as pure insight, for it disavows the immediately purposive doing, and as pure intention, for it disavows the intention of proving itself freed from the purposes of singularity.
zh: 据此，在合目的性方面我们看到，当信仰着的个体通过现实地放弃自然的享受和快乐、并通过行为证明它并没有谎称对它们的蔑视，而是这种蔑视是真的，从而给自己那种更高的意识，即不被自然的享受和快乐所束缚的时候，启蒙觉得这是愚蠢的。
——同样，它也觉得这是愚蠢的：个体通过自己放弃自己的财产，把自己从这样一种规定性中解脱出来，即它是绝对单个的、排斥其他一切并占有财产的规定性；个体由此在真理中表明，它对自己的孤立并不认真，而是已经超越了那种自然必然性，即把自己单一化、并且在这种自为存在的绝对单一化中否认其他个体与自己相同。
——纯粹识见认为两者既不合目的又不正当，——不合目的，因为为了证明自己摆脱了快乐和占有，就放弃快乐、把自己占有的东西送掉；所以它反倒会把那个为了吃饭而采取现实地吃这一手段的人宣布为傻瓜。
——它还认为这是不正当的：不吃一顿饭，并且不把黄油、鸡蛋拿去换钱、也不把钱拿去换黄油和鸡蛋，而是干脆送掉，不为此收回任何这类事物；它宣称一顿饭或对这类事物的占有本身就是目的，并因此在事实上宣称自己是一种很不纯粹的意图，这种意图完全是为了这样的享受和占有。
它作为纯粹意图又重新主张必须超越自然存在、超越对手段的贪婪；只是它觉得这是愚蠢和不正当的：这种超越应当通过行为来证明，——或者，这种纯粹意图在真理中就是欺骗，它假装并要求一种内心的超越，却把认真对待它、现实地把它付诸实行并证明它的真理说成是多余的、愚蠢的、甚至不正当的。
所以它既作为纯粹识见否认自己，因为它否认直接合目的的行动，也作为纯粹意图否认自己，因为它否认那种要证明自己已从单个性的目的中解脱出来的意图。

en: Thus enlightenment lets itself be experienced by faith.

It appears in this bad guise because, precisely through the relation to an other, it gives itself a negative reality or presents itself as the opposite of itself; but pure insight and intention must give itself this relation, for it is their realization.
– This appeared at first as negative reality.
Perhaps its positive reality is better constituted; let us see how this stands.
– When all prejudice and superstition have been banished, the question arises, what now further?
Which is the truth that enlightenment has spread in place of those?
– It has already expressed this positive content in its extirpation of error, for that estrangement of itself is just as much its positive reality.

– In that which is absolute spirit for faith, it takes whatever determination it discovers in it as wood, stone and so on, as individual actual things; since it generally comprehends all determinacy, that is, all content and the fulfillment of the same, in this way as a finitude, as human essence and representation, the absolute essence becomes for it a vacuum to which no determinations, no predicates can be attributed.
Such a coupling would be in itself punishable; and it is precisely this in which the monsters of superstition have been engendered.

Reason, pure insight, is indeed itself not empty, since the negative of itself is for it and is its content, but rich, though only in singularity and limit; to let nothing of the sort accrue to the absolute essence nor to attribute it to it is its insightful way of life, which knows how to put itself and its wealth of finitude in their place and to treat the absolute worthily.
zh: 启蒙就是这样让信仰去经验它的。
它以这种糟糕的样子出现，因为它正是通过对他物的关系给自己一种否定的实在性，或者说把自己表现成自己的反面；但纯粹识见和意图必须给自己这种关系，因为这是它们的实现。
——这起初显现为否定的实在性。
也许它的肯定的实在性状况要好一些；我们来看看它是怎样的情况。
——当一切成见和迷信都被驱除之后，就出现了这个问题：接下来又怎样？
启蒙代替那些东西所传播开来的，究竟是哪一种真理？
——它在自己铲除谬误的过程中已经说出了这个肯定的内容，因为它这种自身的异化同样就是它的肯定的实在性。
——在信仰看来是绝对精神的那个东西身上，它把在那里发现的任何规定都当作木头、石头等等，当作个别的现实之物；由于它一般地把一切规定性、也就是把一切内容和内容的充实，都这样以概念把握为一种有限性、把握为人的本质和表象，绝对本质对它来说就变成了一个真空，不能给这个真空附加任何规定、任何谓词。
这样一种交合自在地就是该受惩罚的；而正是在这种交合中，迷信的怪物才被产生出来。
理性、纯粹识见本身诚然不是空的，因为它的否定物对它来说存在着、并且就是它的内容，而是丰富的，但仅仅在个别性和限制上丰富；不把这类东西算给绝对本质、也不把它附加给绝对本质，就是它那种富有识见的生活方式，这种生活方式懂得把自己和自己那种有限性的财富放到它们该在的位置上，并且懂得有尊严地对待绝对者。

en: Over against this empty essence there stands, as the second moment of the positive truth of enlightenment, the singularity in general of consciousness and of all being, excluded from an absolute essence, as absolute being-in-and-for-itself.

Consciousness, which in its very first actuality is sense-certainty and meaning, here returns thither out of the whole path of its experience and is again a knowing of the purely negative of itself, or of sensuous things, i.e. of beings that stand indifferently over against its being-for-itself.
But here it is not immediate natural consciousness, but has become such for itself.
At first abandoned to all the entanglement into which it is plunged by its unfolding, now led back by pure insight to its first shape, it has experienced this shape as the result.

Grounded on the insight into the nullity of all other shapes of consciousness and thus of everything beyond sense-certainty, this sense-certainty is no longer meaning, but is rather the absolute truth.

This nullity of everything that goes beyond sense-certainty is indeed only a negative proof of this truth; but it is capable of no other, for the positive truth of sense-certainty in itself is precisely the unmediated being-for-itself of the concept itself as object, and indeed in the form of otherness, – that it is absolutely certain to every consciousness that it is, and other actual things besides it, and that it is in its natural being, as these things are, in and for itself or absolutely.
zh: 与这个空洞的本质相对，作为启蒙的肯定真理的第二个环节而站立着的，是被排除在一个绝对本质之外的、意识和一切存在的一般个别性，作为绝对的自在自为存在。
意识在它最初的现实性中是感性确定性和意谓，它在这里从自己经验的整条道路返回那里，并且又成为关于它自身的纯粹否定物的知识，或者关于感性之物的知识，即关于存在者的知识，这些存在者漠然地与它的自为存在相对而立。
但它在这里并不是直接的、自然的意识，而是对自己成了这样的意识。
起初它被交给一切纠缠，即它通过自己的展开而陷入其中的那些纠缠，现在则通过纯粹识见被带回到它最初的形态，它已经把这个形态作为结果经验到了。
建立在关于意识的一切其他形态、从而关于感性确定性的一切彼岸之物的虚无性的识见之上，这种感性确定性不再是意谓，而毋宁是绝对真理。
一切超出感性确定性的东西的这种虚无性，诚然只是这种真理的一个否定的证明；但它不能有别的证明，因为感性确定性自身的肯定真理恰恰就是概念本身作为对象的无中介的自为存在，并且是在他在的形式中，——即对每一个意识来说都绝对确定的是：它存在着，并且在它之外还有别的现实之物，而且它在自己的自然存在中、就像这些事物一样，是自在自为的或绝对的。

en: The third moment of the truth of enlightenment, finally, is the relation of the singular essences to the absolute essence, the relation of the first two.
Insight, as pure insight of the same or the unlimited, also goes beyond the unlike, namely finite actuality, or beyond itself as mere otherness.
It has as the beyond of the unlike the void, to which it therefore relates sensuous actuality.
The two sides do not enter into the determination of this relation as content, for the one is the void, and a content is therefore present only through the other, sensuous actuality.

But the form of the relation, in whose determination the side of the in-itself cooperates, can be made at will; for the form is the negative in itself and therefore the self-opposing; being as well as nothing; the in-itself as well as the opposite; or, what is the same, the relation of actuality to the in-itself as the beyond is just as much a negating as a positing of it.
Finite actuality can therefore properly be taken just as one happens to need it.
The sensuous is therefore now positively related to the absolute as to the in-itself, and sensuous actuality is itself in itself; the absolute makes, cherishes and tends it.
Again, it is also related to it as to the opposite, as to its non-being; according to this relation it is not in itself, but only for an other.

If in the preceding shape of consciousness the concepts of opposition determined themselves as good and evil, then for pure insight, by contrast, they become the purer abstractions of being-in-itself and being-for-an-other.
zh: 最后，启蒙的真理的第三个环节是各个个别本质对绝对本质的关系，即前两个环节的关联。
识见作为相同者或无限制者的纯粹识见，也超出不相同者、即有限的现实性，或者超出作为单纯他在的自身。
它以空洞作为不相同者的彼岸，于是把感性现实性关联到这个空洞上。
在这个关系的规定中，双方并不是作为内容而进入的，因为一方是空洞，所以内容只有通过另一方、即感性现实性才存在。
但是，自在的那一方也参与其规定的这个关系的形式，可以随人所愿地造成；因为形式是自在的否定物，所以是自身对立着的东西；既是存在又是无；既是自在又是反面；或者，这同样是说，现实性对作为彼岸的自在的关系，既是对它的否定，也是对它的设定。
所以，有限的现实性其实可以随人当下的需要而被采取。
于是感性之物现在被肯定地关联到绝对者、关联到自在，而感性现实性本身就是自在的；绝对者制造它、照料它、养护它。
反过来，它又被关联到绝对者，作为反面、作为它的非存在；按照这种关系，它不是自在的，而只是为一个他者。
如果说在意识的先行形态中，对立的诸概念把自己规定为善和恶，那么对纯粹识见来说，它们反而变成自在存在和为他存在这两个更纯粹的抽象。

en: Both ways of considering it, the positive as well as the negative relation of the finite to the in-itself, are however in fact equally necessary, and everything is therefore as much in itself as it is for an other, or everything is useful.
– Everything gives itself up to others, lets itself now be used by others and is for them; and now it rears up again, so to speak, is coy towards others, is for itself and in turn uses the other.
– For man, as the thing conscious of this relation, there results from this his essence and his position.

As he immediately is, as natural consciousness, he is in himself good, as singular absolute, and the other is for him; and indeed, since for him as the animal conscious of itself the moments have the significance of universality, everything is for his pleasure and delight, and he goes about in the world, as he came from God's hand, as in a garden planted for him.

– He must also have plucked from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; in this he possesses a use that distinguishes him from everything else, for it happens that his nature, good in itself, is also so constituted that excess of delight does it harm, or rather his singularity too has its beyond in it, can go beyond itself and destroy itself.
Against this, reason is for him a useful means of properly limiting this going-beyond, or rather of preserving itself in the going-beyond of the determinate; for this is the power of consciousness.

The enjoyment of the conscious essence that is in itself universal must, in respect of manifoldness and duration, itself not be something determinate but universal; the measure therefore has the determination of preventing pleasure from being broken off in its manifoldness and duration; i.e. the determination of the measure is excess.
– As everything is useful to man, so he too is useful, and just as much is it his determination to make himself into a commonly useful and universally serviceable member of the troop.
As much as he cares for himself, just so much must he also give himself up for the others, and as much as he gives himself up, so much does he care for himself; one hand washes the other.
But wherever he finds himself, he is in the right place there; he is of use to others and is used.
zh: 但是，这两种考察方式，即有限者对自在的肯定关系和否定关系，事实上同样必要，所以一切东西既是自在的，又是为一个他者而存在的，或者说，一切东西都是有用的。
——一切东西都把自己交付给其他东西，现在让自己被其他东西使用，并且是为着它们的；而现在它可以说又用后腿立了起来，对别的东西摆出倔强的姿态，是为着自己的，并且反过来使用别的东西。
——对于人，作为意识到这种关系的物，由此就得出了他的本质和他的地位。
他像他直接所是的那样，作为自然的意识，自在地是善的，作为个别者是绝对的，而别的东西是为着他的；而且，因为对他这个意识到自身的动物来说，这些环节具有普遍性的意义，所以一切东西都是为了他的享乐和愉悦，而他就像从上帝手中出来时那样，在世界中走动，把这世界当作为他栽种的一座花园。
——他也必定已经从善与恶的认识之树上摘过果子；他由此拥有一种用处，这种用处把他与一切别的东西区别开来，因为凑巧的是，他那种自在善良的本性也是这样的：过度的愉悦会损害它，或者更确切地说，他的个别性也在自身那里有自己的彼岸，能够超出自身并毁灭自己。
与此相反，理性对他来说是一种有用的手段，用来适当地限制这种超出，或者更确切地说，用来在超出规定之物的过程中保持自身；因为这就是意识的力。
对那个意识到的、自在地普遍的本质的享受，按照多样性和持续时间来说，本身不能是某种被规定的东西，而必须是普遍的；所以尺度具有这样的规定：阻止享乐在它的多样性和持续时间中被中断；也就是说，尺度的规定就是无尺度。
——正如一切东西对人来说都是有用的，人本身也同样有用，而他的规定同样在于：把自己造成这个队伍中共同有用的、普遍可用的成员。
他为自身操多少心，也就必须为其他的人献出多少，他献出多少，就为自身操多少心；一只手洗另一只手。
但无论他处在什么地方，他在那里都恰到好处；他对别人有用，也被别人利用。

en: Other things are useful to one another in another way; but all things have this useful reciprocity through their essence, namely that they are related to the absolute in a doubled way, – the positive one, thereby to be in and for themselves, the negative one, thereby to be for others.

The relation to the absolute essence, or religion, is therefore, among all usefulness, the most useful of all; for it is pure usefulness itself, it is this persistence of all things or their being-in-and-for-itself, and the falling of all things or their being-for-another.
zh: 他者以另一种方式彼此有用；但一切物都通过自己的本质而拥有这种有用的相互性，也就是说，它们以双重方式与绝对者相关联，——肯定的一重，由此自在自为地是自身，否定的一重，由此为他者存在。
因此，对绝对本质的关系、或者说宗教，在一切有用性中是最有用的；因为它就是纯粹的有用性本身，它就是一切物的这种持存、或者说它们的自在自为存在，也是一切物的沉落、或者说它们的为他存在。

en: To faith, admittedly, this positive result of enlightenment is just as much an abomination as its negative comportment toward it.

This insight into the absolute essence, – which sees nothing in it but precisely the absolute essence, the être suprême, or the void, – this intention, that everything in its immediate determinate being is in itself or good, that finally the concept of usefulness exhaustively expresses the relation of the singular conscious being to the absolute essence, religion, is to faith absolutely abhorrent.

This wisdom proper to enlightenment necessarily appears to it at the same time as flatness itself and as the confession of flatness; because it consists in knowing nothing of the absolute essence, or, what is the same, in knowing of it this quite flat truth, that it is precisely only the absolute essence, while knowing only of finitude, and indeed [knowing] it as the true, and knowing this knowledge of it as the true to be the highest.
zh: 当然，对信仰来说，启蒙的这个肯定的结果，与它对信仰的否定态度一样，都是可憎之物。
这种对绝对本质的识见，——它在绝对本质中看到的无非是绝对本质本身、即 être suprême、或空洞，——这种意图，即一切东西在它的直接定在中都是自在的或善的，最后有用性的概念穷尽无遗地表达了单个意识存在对绝对本质的关系、即宗教，——这种识见和这种意图，对信仰来说绝对令人厌恶。
启蒙这种本己的智慧，在信仰看来必然同时就是平庸本身，又是对平庸的招认；因为它就在于：关于绝对本质什么也不知道，或者——这是一回事——关于它知道这条无比平淡的真理，即它恰恰只是绝对本质，相反则只知道有限性，而且把有限性当作真的东西[来知道]，并把这种关于有限性之为真的东西的知识当作最高的东西来知道。

en: Faith has the divine right, the right of absolute self-equality or of pure thinking, against enlightenment, and suffers thorough wrong from it; for it twists faith in all its moments and makes them into something other than they are in it.

But it has only a human right against faith and for its truth; for the wrong that it commits is the right of inequality and consists in twisting and altering, a right that belongs to the nature of self-consciousness in opposition to the simple essence or to thinking.

But since its right is the right of self-consciousness, it will not only also retain its right, so that two equal rights of the spirit would remain standing over against one another and neither could satisfy the other, but it will assert the absolute right, because self-consciousness is the negativity of the concept, which is not only for itself but also reaches out over its opposite; and faith itself, because it is consciousness, will not be able to deny it its right.
zh: 信仰拥有神圣的法权，即绝对自身等同或纯粹思维的法权，来对抗启蒙，并从启蒙那里遭受彻底的不法；因为启蒙在信仰的一切环节上把它颠倒，并把它们弄成不同于它们在信仰中所是的东西。
但它用来对抗信仰、并为着自己的真理而拥有的，只是人的法权；因为它所犯的不法就是不等同的法权，并且在于颠倒和改变，——这种法权属于自我意识的本性，即在同单纯本质或思维相对立时的本性。
但是，既然它的法权是自我意识的法权，那么它就不只是也会保住自己的法权，以致精神的两种同等法权会彼此对立地并存下去、哪一方都无法使另一方满足，而是会主张绝对的法权，因为自我意识是概念的否定性，这种否定性不仅自为地存在，而且还伸及自己的对立面；而信仰本身，因为它是意识，将无法拒绝把法权给它。

en: For enlightenment does not comport itself toward believing consciousness with principles peculiar to itself, but with such as this consciousness itself has in it.

It only brings together for it its own thoughts, which fall apart for it unconsciously; it only reminds it, in the case of one of its modes, of the others that it also has, but one of which it always forgets alongside the other.

It proves itself to be pure insight precisely by this, that in a determinate moment it sees the whole, thus brings along the opposite that relates to that moment, and, twisting each in the other, drives out the negative essence of both thoughts, the concept.

It therefore appears to faith as distortion and lie, because it points out the otherness of its moments; it thereby seems to it to make immediately something other out of them than they are in their singularity; but this other is just as essential, and it is in truth present in the believing consciousness itself, only that this consciousness does not think of it but has it elsewhere; hence it is neither foreign to it, nor can it be denied by it.
zh: 因为启蒙对信仰着的意识并不是以自己固有的原则行事，而是以这种意识本身在自身上具有的原则行事。
它只是把信仰自己的、对它来说无意识地分散开来的思想聚集起来；它只是在它的某一种方式上使它想起它也拥有的其他方式，但它总是在一种方式那里忘掉另一种方式。
它恰恰由此对信仰表明自己是纯粹识见：它在某一个特定的环节上看到整体，因而把与那个环节相关的对立面带过来，并在把一方在另一方中加以颠倒时，把两个思想的否定本质、即概念逼出来。
所以它在信仰看来是颠倒和谎言，因为它揭示出信仰诸环节的他在；它由此在信仰看来直接就把它们弄成了不同于它们在个别性中所是的东西；但这个他者同样是本质性的，而且它在真理中就在信仰着的意识本身那里现成存在，只是这种意识并不想到它，而是在别处拥有它；因此它既不对信仰来说是陌生的，也不可能被信仰否认掉。

en: But enlightenment itself, which reminds faith of the opposite of its separated moments, is just as little enlightened about itself.
It comports itself purely negatively toward faith, insofar as it excludes its content from its purity and takes it as the negative of itself.

It therefore recognizes itself neither in this negative, in the content of faith, nor, for this reason, does it bring the two thoughts together, the one that it brings along and the one against which it brings it along.

Since it does not recognize that what it condemns in faith is immediately its own thought, it is itself, in the opposition of the two moments, such that of these it only acknowledges the one, namely in each case the one opposed to faith, while the other, just as faith does, it separates from it.
It therefore does not bring forth the unity of both as the unity of the same, that is, the concept; but the concept arises for it on its own, or it only finds it as present at hand.

For in itself this is precisely the realization of pure insight, that it, whose essence is the concept, first becomes an absolutely other to itself and disowns itself – for the opposite of the concept is the absolute – and out of this otherness comes to itself or to its concept.

– But enlightenment is only this movement, it is the still unconscious activity of the pure concept, which indeed comes to itself as object, but takes this object for another, and also does not know the nature of the concept, namely that it is the undifferentiated that absolutely separates itself.

– Against faith, then, insight is the power of the concept insofar as it is the movement and the relating of the moments that lie apart in its consciousness, a relating in which the contradiction of these moments comes to appearance.

Herein lies the absolute right of the violence that it exercises over faith; but the actuality to which it brings this violence [lies] precisely in this, that the believing consciousness is itself the concept and thus itself acknowledges the opposite that insight brings along for it.
It therefore remains in the right against faith, because it asserts in faith what is necessary to faith itself and what faith has in itself.
zh: 但启蒙本身，既然它使信仰想起它那些分离环节的对立面，也就同样没有对自身启蒙。
它对待信仰完全是否定性的，因为它把自己的内容从自己的纯粹性中排除出去，并把它当作它自己的否定物。
所以它既不在这否定物中、在信仰的内容中认识到自己，也由于这个原因不把两个思想聚集起来，即它所带过来的那个思想，和它把前者带过来所针对的那个思想。
由于它不认识这一点，即它在信仰身上所谴责的东西直接就是它自己的思想，所以它自己在两个环节的对立中就是这样：这两个环节中，它只承认其中一个、即每次都是与信仰相对立的那个，而另一个，则恰恰像信仰所做的那样，把它从前者分离开来。
所以它并没有把两者的统一作为这两者的统一、也就是作为概念产生出来；但概念自为地对它产生出来，或者说，它只是把概念当作现成存在的东西来发现。
因为自在说来，这恰恰就是纯粹识见的实现：它——其本质是概念——首先对自己成为一个绝对的他者并否认自己——因为概念的对立面就是绝对者——，并且从这种他在回到自身、或者说回到它的概念。
——但启蒙只是这一运动，它是纯粹概念那还没有意识的活动，这种活动虽然作为对象回到自身，却把这个对象当作一个他者，也不认识概念的本性，即恰恰是那无差别的东西在绝对地把自己分离开来。
——所以，面对信仰，识见之所以是概念的力，就在于它是那些在信仰意识中分散开来的环节的运动和关联，是一种关联，在其中这些环节的矛盾显露出来。
这里就含有它对信仰所施加的暴力的绝对法权；而它把这种暴力带入的那种现实性，则恰恰在于：信仰着的意识本身就是概念，因而它自己也承认识见给它带过来的那个对立面。
因此它对信仰保持有理，因为它在信仰身上主张的，正是信仰自己必然具有的、并且信仰在自身上就具有的东西。

en: First enlightenment asserts that the moment of the concept is a doing of consciousness; it asserts this against faith, – that its absolute essence is the essence of its consciousness as a self, or that it is brought forth by consciousness.

For believing consciousness, its absolute essence, just as it is in itself for it, is at the same time not like a foreign thing that stood therein, one knows not how or whence; rather, its trust consists precisely in finding itself therein as this personal consciousness, and its obedience and service in bringing it forth as its absolute essence through its doing.
Enlightenment actually reminds faith only of this, when faith purely expresses the in-itself of the absolute essence beyond the doing of consciousness.

– But since it does indeed bring along, against the one-sidedness of faith, the opposite moment of faith's own doing, namely the one directed against the being that faith here alone thinks of, but itself likewise does not bring its thoughts together, it isolates the pure moment of doing and declares of faith's in-itself that it is only something brought forth by consciousness.
But the isolated doing, opposed to the in-itself, is a contingent doing and, as a representing one, a producing of fictions,
– representations that are not in themselves; and in this way it considers the content of faith.
– Conversely, however, pure insight likewise says the opposite.
In asserting the moment of otherness that the concept has in itself, it declares the essence of faith to be such that it does not concern consciousness, is beyond it, is foreign to it and unknown.
For faith it is likewise the case that, as on the one hand it trusts it and therein has the certainty of itself, on the other hand it is inscrutable in its ways and unreachable in its being.
zh: 启蒙首先主张，概念的环节是意识的一种行动；它针对信仰主张这一点，——即信仰的绝对本质是它作为自我的意识之本质，或者说，它是被意识产生出来的。
对信仰着的意识来说，它的绝对本质，正如它对它是自在的那样，同时并不像一个陌生的物那样——人们不知道它如何、从何处存在于其中；相反，它的信任恰恰在于：在绝对本质中把自己作为这个人格的意识发现出来，而它的服从和事奉则在于：通过自己的行动把它作为自己的绝对本质产生出来。
启蒙其实只是使信仰想起这一点：当信仰纯粹说出绝对本质在意识行动之外的自在时。
——但是，它虽然针对信仰的片面性，把信仰自己行动这一对立环节、即针对它在这里唯一想到的存在的那一环节带过来，自己却同样不把它的思想聚集起来，于是它就把行动的纯粹环节孤立起来，并且关于信仰的自在说出这一点：它只是意识产生出来的东西。
但这种被孤立起来的、与自在相对立的行动，是一种偶然的行动，并且作为表象着的行动，是一种虚构的产生，
——一些并不自在的表象；它就是这样来看待信仰的内容的。
——但反过来，纯粹识见同样说出相反的东西。
它既然主张概念在自身上具有的他在环节，就把信仰的本质说成这样一种东西：它不关意识什么事，在意识之外，对意识来说是陌生的、未被认识的。
对信仰来说情形同样如此：它一方面信任绝对本质，并在其中拥有对自身的确定性，另一方面，绝对本质在自己的道路上不可探究，在自己的存在中不可达到。

en: Further, enlightenment asserts against the believing consciousness a right in this, a right that the latter itself concedes, if it regards the object of its veneration as stone and wood or otherwise as a finite, anthropomorphic determinacy.

For since it is this divided consciousness, having a beyond of actuality and a pure this-side of that beyond, this view of the sensuous thing is in fact also present in it, according to which the sensuous thing counts as in and for itself; but it does not bring together these two thoughts of the being that exists in and for itself, which is for it now the pure essence, now a common sensuous thing.

– Even its pure consciousness is affected by the latter view; for the differences of its supersensuous kingdom are, because it lacks the concept, a series of independent shapes, and their movement a happening, i.e. they are only in representation and have on them the manner of sensuous being.

– Enlightenment for its part likewise isolates actuality as an essence abandoned by spirit, determinacy as an immovable finitude, which would not be a moment in the spiritual movement of the essence itself, not nothing, nor a something existing in and for itself, but a vanishing thing.
zh: 此外，启蒙在这一点上针对信仰着的意识主张一种权利，这种权利是信仰着的意识自己也认可的，如果启蒙把信仰所崇敬的对象看作石头和木头，或者看作别的某种有限的、拟人的规定性的话。
因为既然它是这种分裂的意识，拥有一个现实性的彼岸、以及那个彼岸的一个纯粹的此岸，那么这种关于感性的物的观点在它那里事实上也存在，按照这种观点，感性的物是自在自为地有效的；但它并不把自在自为存在者的这两个想法结合起来，这个自在自为存在者对它来说一会儿是纯粹本质，一会儿是一个普通的感性之物。
——就连它的纯粹意识也受到后一种观点的影响；因为它的超感性王国的那些差别，由于它缺少概念，是一系列独立的形态，而它们的运动则是一个事件，也就是说，它们只存在于表象之中，并且身上带有感性存在的方式。
——启蒙在它这一方面同样把现实性孤立为一种被精神离弃了的本质，把规定性孤立为一种不可移动的有限性，这种有限性不会是本质自身的精神运动中的一个环节，不是无，也不是一个自在自为地存在着的某物，而是一个消逝着的东西。

en: It is clear that the same is the case with the ground of knowing.
