The believing consciousness itself acknowledges a contingent knowledge; for it has a relation to contingencies, and the absolute essence itself is for it in the form of a represented, common actuality; hereby the believing consciousness is also a certainty that does not have the truth in itself, and it confesses itself to be such an unessential consciousness on this side of the spirit that assures and proves itself.
– But it forgets this moment in its spiritual, immediate knowledge of the absolute essence.

– But enlightenment, which reminds it of this, again thinks only of the contingent knowledge and forgets the other, – thinks only of the mediation that happens through a foreign third, not of that in which the immediate is itself the third, whereby it mediates itself with the other, namely with itself.
zh: 很明显，就知识的根据来说，情况也是如此。
信仰着的意识自己也承认一种偶然的知识；因为它与偶然性有一种关系，而绝对本质本身是以一种被表象的普通现实性的形式对它存在的；因此信仰着的意识也是一种自身并不具有真理的确定性，并且它自认是这样一个非本质的意识，处在那个自己使自己确定并证明自己的精神的此岸。
——但它在自己对绝对本质的精神的、直接的知识中忘记了这一环节。
——但是，提醒它注意这一点的启蒙，又只想到偶然的知识，忘记了另一个方面，——只想到通过一个陌生的第三者而发生的中介，而不去想到这样一种中介，在其中直接者自己就是第三者，直接者由此使自己与他者、也就是与自己中介起来。

en: Finally, in its view of the doing of faith, it finds the throwing away of enjoyment and of possessions wrong and inexpedient.

– As regards the wrong, it receives the agreement of the believing consciousness in this, that the latter itself acknowledges this actuality, that it possesses, holds fast and enjoys property; in the assertion of property it behaves all the more isolated and obstinate, and in its enjoyment all the more crudely given over, since its religious doing – the doing that gives up possession and enjoyment – falls beyond this actuality and has bought it freedom on this side of actuality.

This service of sacrificing natural impulse and enjoyment has, through this opposition, in fact no truth; the retention takes place alongside the sacrifice; the sacrifice is only a sign, which real sacrifice carries out only on a small part and therefore in fact only represents.
zh: 最后，在它对信仰的行动的看法中，它认为抛弃享受和财物是不正当的、不合目的的。
——就这种不正当来说，它在这方面得到信仰着的意识的赞同，即信仰着的意识自己也承认这种现实性，承认自己占有、保住并享受财产；它在主张财产时越是孤立和固执，在自己的享受中就越是粗野地听任自己，因为它的宗教的行动——放弃占有和享受的行动——落在这种现实性的彼岸，并给它换来了在现实性这一边的自由。
这种牺牲自然冲动和享受的服务，由于这种对立，事实上并没有真理；保留是与牺牲并行发生的；牺牲只是一个符号，现实的牺牲只在很小一部分上完成这一符号，因此在事实上只是把牺牲表象出来。

en: With regard to purposiveness, enlightenment finds it inept to throw away a possession in order to know and prove oneself freed from possession, to refuse an enjoyment in order to know and prove oneself freed from enjoyment.

The believing consciousness itself comprehends the absolute doing as a universal doing; not only is the action of its absolute essence as its object a universal one for it, but the individual consciousness too is supposed to prove itself wholly and universally freed from its sensuous essence.

But the throwing away of a single possession or the renouncing of a single enjoyment is not this universal action; and since in the action the purpose, which is a universal, and the execution, which is a single one, would have to stand before consciousness in their inadequacy, the action proves itself to be one in which consciousness has no part, and hereby this action [proves itself] properly as too naive to be an action; it is too naive to fast in order to be freed from the pleasure of the meal, – too naive, like Origen, to remove other pleasure from the body in order to prove it done away with.
The action itself proves to be an external and single doing; but desire is inwardly rooted and a universal; its pleasure vanishes neither with the instrument nor through individual deprivation.
zh: 在合目的性方面，启蒙认为，为了知道自己已从财物中解脱出来并证明这一点而抛弃一份财物，为了知道自己已从享受中解脱出来并证明这一点而拒绝一次享受，是笨拙的。
信仰着的意识自己把绝对的行动看作一种普遍的行动；对它来说，不仅它的绝对本质作为它的对象的行动是普遍的，而且个别意识也应当证明自己完全地、普遍地从自己的感性本质中解脱出来。
但抛弃一件个别的财物、或放弃一次个别的享受，并不是这种普遍的行动；而由于在行动中，目的——它是普遍的——和执行——它是单个的——必然会在意识面前显出它们的不相称，所以这种行动表明自己是这样一种行动，意识在其中毫无份，因此这种行动其实太天真，不足以成为行动；为了从用餐的快乐中解脱出来而绝食，这太天真，——像奥利金那样把别的快乐从身上除掉，以证明它已被去掉，也太天真。
行动本身表明自己是一种外在的、单个的行动；但欲望是内在地生了根的，并且是普遍的，它的快乐既不会随着工具而消失，也不会通过个别的匮乏而消失。

en: But enlightenment, for its part, here isolates the inward, the unreal, over against actuality, just as it held fast, against the inwardness of faith in its intuition and devotion, the externality of thinghood.

It places the essential in the intention, in the thought, and thereby spares itself the real accomplishment of liberation from natural purposes; on the contrary, this inwardness is itself the formal, which has its fulfillment in the natural drives, and these are justified precisely by being inward, by belonging to universal being, to nature.
zh: 但启蒙在它这一方面在这里把内在的、非现实的东西孤立起来，使之与现实现性对立，就像它曾经针对信仰在直观和虔诚中的内在性而坚持物性的外在性那样。
它把本质性的东西放进意图、放进思想里，并由此省掉了现实地完成从自然目的中解脱出来这件事；相反，这种内在性本身就是形式的东西，它在自然冲动身上得到自己的充实，而自然冲动恰恰由此得到辩护：它们是内在的，它们属于普遍的存在、自然。

en: Enlightenment therefore has an irresistible power over faith because the moments that it asserts are to be found in faith's own consciousness.

Considered more closely, the effect of this force seems to tear apart its behaviour towards faith, the beautiful unity of trust and immediate certainty, to defile its spiritual consciousness through low thoughts of sensuous actuality, to destroy its mind, calmed and secure in its submission, through the vanity of the understanding and of its own will and accomplishment.
But in fact it rather initiates the sublation of the thoughtless, or rather concept-less, separation that is present in it.

The believing consciousness keeps a double measure and weight; it has two kinds of eyes, two kinds of ears, two kinds of tongue and language; it has doubled all representations without comparing this double meaning.

Or faith lives in two kinds of perception, the one, the perception of the sleeping consciousness living purely in concept-less thoughts, the other that of the waking consciousness living purely in sensuous actuality, and in each it keeps its own household,

– Enlightenment illuminates that heavenly world with the representations of the sensuous, and points out to that world this finitude, which faith cannot deny, because it is self-consciousness and hereby the unity to which both modes of representation belong and in which they do not fall apart; for they belong to the same inseparable simple self, into which faith has passed over.
zh: 所以，启蒙对信仰有一种不可抗拒的强力，因为在信仰自己的意识中就可以找到它所要主张的那些环节。
更切近地考察这种力的作用，那么它对信仰的行为似乎要撕碎信任和直接确定性的美的统一，用感性现实性的低劣思想玷污它的精神意识，并通过知性以及自己的意志和成就的虚浮，摧毁它那种在臣服中安静下来并感到安稳的心境。
但事实上，它倒是开启了那种无思想的、或者说无概念的分裂的扬弃，这种分裂存在于信仰之中。
信仰着的意识使用双重的尺度和重量，它有两套眼睛、两套耳朵、两套舌头和语言，它把一切表象都加倍了，却并不比较这种双重意义。
或者说，信仰生活在两种知觉中，一种是沉睡的、纯粹生活在无概念的思想中的意识的知觉，另一种是觉醒的、纯粹生活在感性现实性中的意识的知觉，而在每一种知觉中它都操持着自己的一套家务，
——启蒙用感性之物的表象照亮那个天上的世界，并向那个世界指出这种有限性，而信仰不能否认这种有限性，因为信仰是自我意识，因而也就是那样一种统一性，两种表象方式都属于这种统一性，并且在这种统一性中它们不会彼此分裂；因为它们属于同一个不可分割的、单纯的自我，而信仰已经过渡到这个自我中去了。

en: Faith has thereby lost the content that filled its element and collapses into a dull weaving of the spirit within itself.

It is driven out of its kingdom, or this kingdom is plundered, in that the waking consciousness has torn to itself all distinction and expansion of it and has claimed and given back all its parts to the earth as the earth's property.

But it is not satisfied on that account, for through this illumination only individual essences have arisen everywhere, so that only essenceless actuality and finitude abandoned by the spirit address the spirit.

– Since it is without content and cannot remain in this emptiness, or since, going beyond the finite, which is the only content, it finds only the empty, it is a pure yearning, its truth an empty beyond for which no suitable content can any longer be found, for everything has another relation.

– Faith has thereby in fact become the same as enlightenment, namely the consciousness of the relation of the finite existing in itself to the predicate-less, unrecognized and unrecognizable absolute; only that enlightenment is the satisfied and faith the unsatisfied enlightenment.
It will, however, show itself in enlightenment whether it can remain in its satisfaction; that yearning of the dark spirit, which mourns over the loss of its spiritual world, stands in ambush.

Enlightenment itself has this blemish of unsatisfied yearning on it, – as pure object on its empty absolute essence, – as doing and movement in the going beyond its singular being to the unfulfilled beyond, – as fulfilled object on the selflessness of the useful.
It will sublate this blemish; from the closer consideration of the positive result, which is the truth for it, it will follow that this blemish is already in itself sublated in it.
zh: 信仰由此失去了那个曾充满它的要素的内容，并沉入精神在它自身之内的一种沉闷的编织之中。
它被逐出自己的王国，或者说这个王国被劫掠一空，因为觉醒的意识把王国的一切区分和展开都据为己有，并把它的各个部分全都作为大地自己的财产判归大地、交还给大地。
但它并不因此就得到满足，因为通过这种照明，到处都只产生出个别的本质，以致向精神说话的只是无本质的现实性和被精神离弃了的有限性。
——由于它没有内容，又不能停留在这空虚之中，或者说，由于它超出那唯一的内容即有限的东西而只找到空虚，所以它是一种纯粹的渴望，它的真理是一个空虚的彼岸，对这个彼岸再也找不到任何相称的内容，因为一切都另有关联。
——信仰由此事实上已经变成了和启蒙一样的东西，即变成了对自在存在着的有限者与那个无谓词的、未被认识并且不可认识的绝对者的关系的意识；只不过启蒙是得到满足的启蒙，而信仰是未得到满足的启蒙。
然而在启蒙身上将会表明，它能否停留在自己的满足之中；那个阴郁的精神的渴望——它哀悼自己精神世界的失落——正潜伏着。
启蒙自己身上就带有这种未得到满足的渴望的瑕疵，——作为纯粹的对象，在它那空虚的绝对本质身上，——作为行动和运动，在它超出自己的个别存在而走向未得到充实的彼岸这一点上，——作为得到充实的对象，在有用之物的无我性上。
它将会扬弃这种瑕疵；从更切近地考察那个对它来说是真理的肯定的结果中将会得出：这种瑕疵自在地已经在其中被扬弃了。
